name: Acid Lime / Lemon (Kagzi Nimboo)
confidenceNote: Vijayapura (Bijapur GI lemon) and Tenali lemon capital benchmarks (Balaji / Vikram / Sai Sharbati).
spacing: 5 m x 5 m or 4.5 m x 4.5 m
fertilizerSchedule: 30 kg FYM + 400g N, 200g P, 400g K per tree/year in 2 splits + Micronutrient spray.
harvestSigns: Fruits turn greenish-yellow with smooth thin skin and full juice content.
storageAdvice: Pack in wooden crates or aerated plastic crates; holds 10-14 days at room temperature.
intercroppingOptions: Pulses and vegetables during first 3 years
description: Acid Lime (Vijayapura Kagzi Nimbe) is an evergreen cash generator. Summer lemon prices spike dramatically, delivering massive windfall profits to citrus orchardists.
descriptionKn: ವಿಜಯಪುರದ ಕಾಗಜಿ ನಿಂಬೆಗೆ ಜಿಐ ಟ್ಯಾಗ್ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆಯಿದೆ. ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ನಿಂಬೆಹಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ₹5-8 ಸಿಗುವುದರಿಂದ ಭಾರಿ ಲಾಭ.
descriptionTa: எலுமிச்சை ஆண்டு முழுவதும் பலன் தரும் அமுதப் பயிர். கோடையில் உச்சக்கட்ட விலை போகும்.
descriptionTe: నిమ్మకాయ తెనాలి, నెల్లూరు ప్రాంతాల్లో రైతులకు నిరంతర కాసుల వర్షం కురిపించే పండ్ల తోట.
risks: Citrus canker (Xanthomonas citri) bacterial disease on leaves and rind
Citrus leaf miner on tender flush
benefits: Weekly harvest creates continuous year-round cash flow
Summer juice demand doubles farmer income

name: Aloe Vera (Ghritakumari)
confidenceNote: High barbaloin pharmaceutical and cosmetic succulent benchmark.
harvestMonths: Starts 8 months after planting, then every 3 months
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 5 tonnes/acre annually; chemical fertilizer is avoided for cosmetic grade.
harvestSigns: Lower thick fleshy leaves reach 40-50 cm length with thick gel core.
storageAdvice: Process leaves into stabilized gel within 4-6 hours of harvest.
description: Aloe Vera is an indestructible desert succulent requiring near-zero maintenance. Thrives on gravelly arid soils with no livestock grazing risk, purchased by cosmetics and herbal juice factories.
descriptionKn: ಲೋಳೆಸರಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಕೀಟ-ರೋಗಗಳಿಲ್ಲ, ಹಸು-ಕುರಿಗಳು ತಿನ್ನುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವರ್ಧಕ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳಿಗೆ ನೇರ ಮಾರಾಟ.
descriptionTa: சோற்றுக்கற்றாழை வறண்ட நிலத்தில் மிக எளிதாக வளரும் மருத்துவ பயிர். பராமரிப்பு செலவு மிக குறைவு.
descriptionTe: కలబంద ఎలాంటి చీడపీడలు లేని ఎడారి మొక్క. సౌందర్య సాధనాల కంపెనీలకు నిరంతర సరఫరా.
risks: Root rot if field gets waterlogged in heavy downpours
benefits: Zero pest or disease problems
Zero livestock grazing threat

name: Amaranthus Greens (Dantu / Keerai)
confidenceNote: Fastest leafy green superfood (Arka Suguna / Co 1 / Co 2).

images.author:
https://wellcomeimages.org/indexplus/obf_images/06/c5/45a2335f40ef15625d9e04c08476.jpg (hi-res image)

Gallery: https://wellcomeimages.org/indexplus/image/L0039407.html
Wellcome Collection gallery (2018-03-29): https://wellcomecollection.org/works/v79swgy8 CC-BY-4.0

seedRate: 1-1.5 kg/acre (mixed with sand for even broadcasting)
spacing: Broadcast or 20 cm rows on flat beds
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 20:10:10 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Tender stems and lush leaves 20-25 cm tall.
storageAdvice: Harvest early morning; sprinkle with cool water; market within 12 hours.
description: Amaranthus (Dantu Soppu / Thotakura / Keerai) is the fastest cash-crop in farming. Harvested in just 25-30 days, providing daily cash income for vegetable growers near cities.
descriptionKn: ಕೇವಲ 25-30 ದಿನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ದಂಟು ಸೊಪ್ಪು ನಗರ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ತಾಜಾ ಆದಾಯ ತರುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: 25 நாட்களில் அறுவடையாகும் சிறுகீரை, அரைக்கீரை தினசரி ரொக்க வருமானம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: తోటకూర కేవలం 25-30 రోజుల్లో చేతికొచ్చే నిత్యావసర పచ్చటి ఆకుకూర.
risks: Leaf webber caterpillar
White rust in damp cold weather
benefits: Harvest in just 25 days
Richest in calcium, iron, and dietary fiber

name: Amla / Indian Gooseberry
confidenceNote: High Vitamin C super-fruit benchmarks (NA 7 / Krishna / Kanchan).
spacing: 5 m x 5 m or 4.5 m x 4.5 m
fertilizerSchedule: 20 kg FYM + 250g N, 150g P, 300g K per tree annually.
harvestSigns: Fruits turn light greenish yellow with translucent appearance and brown specks.
storageAdvice: Pack in gunny bags; keeps in ambient storage for 15-20 days without rotting.
description: Amla is the richest natural source of Vitamin C. Thrives in barren, alkaline, and gravelly soils with minimal water. Giant demand for Chyawanprash, hair oils, and herbal extracts.
descriptionKn: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ನೆಲ್ಲಿಕಾಯಿಯು ಕ್ಷಾರ ಮಣ್ಣಲ್ಲೂ ಬಂಗಾರದಂತೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಅಮೃತ ಹಣ್ಣು. ಚ್ಯವನಪ್ರಾಶ ಮತ್ತು ಆಯುರ್ವೇದ ಉದ್ಯಮಕ್ಕೆ ಭಾರಿ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ.
descriptionTa: நெல்லிக்காய் வைட்டமின் சி நிறைந்த காயகற்ப மூலிகை. குறைந்த நீரில் அதிக பலன் தரும்.
descriptionTe: ఉసిరి విటమిన్ సి గని. చౌడు నేలల్లో కూడా పండే అద్భుతమైన ఆయుర్వేద తోట పంట.
risks: Rust disease on fruits
Bark eating caterpillar on older trees
benefits: Highest Vitamin C of any cultivated fruit (600-800 mg/100g)
Grows in alkaline soils up to pH 8.5 where other fruit crops fail

name: Areca nut (Betel Nut / Supari)
confidenceNote: Malnad, Coastal Karnataka (Shivamogga, Chikkamagaluru, Dakshina Kannada) & Kerala arecanut heartland (Mangala / South Kanara / Mohitnagar).

spacing: 2.7 m x 2.7 m (9 ft x 9 ft)
fertilizerSchedule: 20 kg FYM/tree + 100g N, 40g P, 140g K per palm/year in 2 splits (Sept and Feb).
harvestSigns: Chali (ripe): bunches turn deep yellow-orange; Rashi/Kole: harvested tender green for boiling/tanning.
storageAdvice: Sun dry dehusked nuts on cement drying yards for 40-50 days until completely dry and rattle.
description: Areca nut is the financial powerhouse of the Western Ghats and Malnad. With Black Pepper trailed on every trunk and Cocoa/Banana below, multi-tier areca farms earn ₹4-6 Lakhs per acre annually.
descriptionKn: ಮಲೆನಾಡು ಮತ್ತು ಕರಾವಳಿಯ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಬೆನ್ನೆಲುಬು. ಅಡಿಕೆ ಮರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾಳುಮೆಣಸು ಹಬ್ಬಿಸಿ, ನಡುವೆ ಕೋಕೋ, ಬಾಳೆ ಬೆಳೆದು ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಲಾಭ ಗಳಿಸಬಹುದು.
descriptionTa: பாக்கு தென் இந்தியாவின் மிக முக்கியமான பணப்பயிர். மிளகு மற்றும் கொக்கோ ஊடுபயிராக பயிரிட்டு லட்சக்கணக்கில் வருவாய் ஈட்டலாம்.
descriptionTe: పోక తోటల్లో మిరియాలు, కోకో వంటి అంతరపంటలు సాగు చేసి ఎకరానికి రూ. 4 నుంచి 6 లక్షల స్థిరమైన వార్షికాదాయం పొందవచ్చు.
risks: Koleroga / Fruit rot (Phytophthora meadii) during heavy continuous South-West monsoon
Yellow Leaf Disease (YLD) in poorly drained soils
benefits: 40+ years of high, inflation-hedged annual income
Multi-tier cropping generates 3 revenue streams from the same plot

name: Ash Gourd / Winter Melon (Boodu Kumbala)
confidenceNote: Package of practices from TNAU & KAU Kerala (KAU Indu / Co 1).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 40:25:25 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Fruits develop thick waxy white powdery ash coating on the outer rind.
storageAdvice: Unbroken fruits store for 6 to 9 months in a cool, dry room without rotting.
description: Ash gourd (Winter Melon) is famous for its long room-temperature shelf life (up to 9 months) and massive demand for Ayurveda, petha sweets, and health juice.
descriptionKn: ಬೂದುಗುಂಬಳವು 9 ತಿಂಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಕೆಡದೆ ಇರುವ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕಾಯಿ. ಆಯುರ್ವೇದ ಮತ್ತು ಜ್ಯೂಸ್‌ಗೆ ಅಗಾಧ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯಿದೆ.
descriptionTa: சாம்பல் பூசணி 6-9 மாதங்கள் வரை அறையிலேயே கெடாமல் இருக்கும். ஜூஸ் மற்றும் மருத்துவ குணம் மிக்கது.
descriptionTe: బూడిద గుమ్మడి నెలల తరబడి నిల్వ ఉంటుంది. ఆయుర్వేద రసాలకు, వ్యాపారాలకు అత్యంత గిరాకీ.
risks: Caterpillars on young vines
Downy mildew
benefits: Unmatched shelf life (up to 9 months) eliminates market distress sale
Booming urban trend for raw morning health juice

name: Ashwagandha (Indian Ginseng)
confidenceNote: Standard CIMAP / UAS Bangalore dryland medicinal crop package (Jawahar Asgandh 20 / Poshita).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 4 tonnes + 15:15:0 kg N:P:K (organic cultivation preferred by Ayurvedic pharma companies).
harvestSigns: Leaves dry up and berries turn bright orange-red.
storageAdvice: Dig out roots with plows; separate tops; clean and grade roots into A, B, C grades based on length and diameter; dry to 8% moisture.
description: Ashwagandha ("Indian Ginseng") is the world's most popular adaptogenic Ayurvedic herb. Grown with minimal water in dry gravelly soils, pharmaceutical firms buy graded roots at high prices.
descriptionKn: ಅಶ್ವಗಂಧವು ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯಿರುವ ದಿವ್ಯ ಔಷಧೀಯ ಬೆಳೆ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಂಜರು ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲೂ ಬಂಗಾರದಂತಹ ಲಾಭ ತರುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: அமுக்கிராங்கிழங்கு வறண்ட நிலத்தில் பயிராகும் மருத்துவ பயிர். வேர்களுக்கு சர்வதேச சந்தையில் பெரும் மதிப்பு உண்டு.
descriptionTe: అశ్వగంధ అత్యుత్తమ ఆయుర్వేద ఔషధ పంట. రాతి, చౌడు నేలల్లో కూడా తక్కువ నీటితో అద్భుతమైన ఆదాయాన్నిస్తుంది.
risks: Damping off at seedling stage if field is waterlogged
benefits: Zero livestock grazing damage (bitter taste and odor protect it)
High export demand in Europe and USA as stress-relief supplement

name: Banana (Grand Naine / Yelakki)
confidenceNote: Tiruchirappalli (NRCB) and Mandya Cauvery basin tissue culture benchmarks.
spacing: 1.8 m x 1.8 m or 2.1 m x 1.5 m paired row
fertilizerSchedule: 20 kg FYM + 200g N, 60g P, 300g K per plant applied weekly via fertigation.
harvestSigns: Angles of fruits round out and floral ends drop off easily.
storageAdvice: Hang bunches in shade; transport in foam-padded trucks at 14°C.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 25 - 35 Tonnes (Grand Naine: 25-30 kg bunch; Yelakki: 12-15 kg bunch)
intercroppingOptions: Short vegetables (radish, coriander) during first 3 months
description: Banana provides guaranteed year-round cash flow. High-density tissue culture (G9 and fragrant Yelakki/Nendran) yields extraordinary returns in canal basins.
descriptionKn: ತಿಂಗಳು-ತಿಂಗಳು ಖಚಿತ ಆದಾಯ ತರುವ ಬೆಳೆ. ಏಲಕ್ಕಿ ಬಾಳೆ ಮತ್ತು ಜಿ-9 ಬಾಳೆ ತಳಿಗಳು ಭರ್ಜರಿ ಲಾಭ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.
descriptionTa: வாழை வருடம் முழுவதும் நிலையான வருமானம் தரும் அமுதப் பயிர். நேந்திரன், செவ்வாழைக்கு அதிக கிராக்கி.
descriptionTe: అరటి రైతుల పాలిట కామధేనువు. టిష్యూ కల్చర్ మొక్కలతో ఎకరానికి రూ. 3 నుంచి 4 లక్షల నికర లాభం.
risks: Panama wilt (Fusarium oxysporum) in susceptible cultivars
High wind lodging during monsoon (propping with bamboo is mandatory)
benefits: Daily liquid cash flow from local markets and mandis
Second crop (ratoon) matures in just 9 months with 40% lower cost

name: Barley
confidenceNote: Specialized Rabi crop for alkaline and saline soils with malting industry contracts.
fertilizerSchedule: 25:12:12 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Spikes droop and turn golden yellow.
storageAdvice: Maintain below 12% moisture.
description: Barley is exceptionally salt and alkali-tolerant, making it suitable for saline drylands in North Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.
descriptionKn: ಉಪ್ಪು ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ಷಾರ ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಬಹುದಾದ ಧಾನ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: களர் நிலங்களையும் தாங்கி வளரும் சத்துமிக்க குளிர்கால தானியம்.
descriptionTe: చౌడు భూముల్లో కూడా తట్టుకుని పెరిగే ధాన్య పంట.
risks: Loose smut
Aphids during winter
benefits: Tolerates high soil salinity where wheat fails
High demand for health drinks and malt

name: Barnyard Millet (Oodalu / Kuthiraivali)
confidenceNote: Package of practices from UAS Bangalore and TNAU Coimbatore.
fertilizerSchedule: 15:8:8 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Panicles turn light brown and grains are firm.
storageAdvice: Sun dry and store in moisture-proof containers.
description: Barnyard millet (Kuthiraivali/Oodalu) produces the fastest edible grain (ready in 75 days) and has the highest fiber and iron profile.
descriptionKn: ಊದಲು ಅತಿ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆ ಕೊಡುವ ಸಿರಿಧಾನ್ಯ. ನಾರಿನಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಕಬ್ಬಿಣಾಂಶ ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿದೆ.
descriptionTa: குதிரைவாலி 75 நாட்களில் அறுவடைக்கு வரும் அதிவேக சிறுதானியம். இரும்புச்சத்து நிறைந்தது.
descriptionTe: ఊదలు కేవలం 75 రోజుల్లో చేతికొచ్చే బలవర్థకమైన చిరుధాన్యం. పీచు పదార్థం మెండు.
risks: Head smut
Lodging if over-fertilized with nitrogen
benefits: Fastest grain maturity (75 days)
Ideal emergency catch-crop after failed monsoon

name: Beetroot
confidenceNote: Ooty and Bangalore plains package (Detroit Dark Red / Crimson Globe).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 30:25:30 kg N:P:K + Boron 2 kg/acre (prevents brown heart core).
harvestSigns: Roots reach 5-7 cm diameter with smooth deep crimson skin.
storageAdvice: Trim tops 2 cm above crown; holds 10-14 days in cool storage.
description: Beetroot is a fast 70-day crimson root vegetable loaded with dietary nitrates and antioxidants. High urban juice and salad bar demand.
descriptionKn: ರಕ್ತಹೀನತೆ ನಿವಾರಣೆಗೆ ರಾಮಬಾಣವಾದ ಬೀಟ್‌ರೂಟ್ ಕೇವಲ 70 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಆದಾಯ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: பீட்ரூட் ரத்த அணுக்களை அதிகரிக்கும் ஆரோக்கிய காய்கறி. 70 நாட்களில் அறுவடையாகும்.
descriptionTe: బీట్‌రూట్ రక్తాన్ని వృద్ధి చేసే అద్భుతమైన దుంప కూరగాయ. మంచి మార్కెట్ విలువ.
risks: Cercospora leaf spot in humid spells
Internal black spot if Boron is deficient
benefits: Fast 70-day harvest
High urban juice stall demand

name: Ber / Indian Jujube (Apple Ber)
confidenceNote: Apple Ber and Umran drought-hardy arid commercial benchmarks.
waterMm: 250-400 mm, king of arid desert fruits
rainfallMm: 300-600 mm, sheds leaves and goes dormant during hot dry summer
spacing: 5 m x 5 m (heavy pruning annually in May)
fertilizerSchedule: 20 kg FYM + 250g N, 100g P, 150g K per tree after annual May pruning.
harvestSigns: Fruits turn greenish yellow or crisp red; skin becomes glossy.
storageAdvice: Pack in wooden or ventilated plastic crates; keeps 7-10 days.
description: Ber (Apple Ber) is the undisputed King of Arid Fruits. Survives extreme heat up to 44°C and high salinity (pH up to 9.0), producing 10 tonnes of apple-like crisp fruits in year 2.
descriptionKn: ಆಪಲ್ ಬೋರ್ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ, ಬಿಸಿಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸವಳು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲೂ ಸೇಬಿನಂತಹ ರುಚಿಕರ ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: ஆப்பிள் இலந்தை கடுமையான வறட்சியிலும் செழித்து விளையும் அதிவேக பழப்பயிர்.
descriptionTe: ఆపిల్ బేర్ చౌడు, రాతి నేలల్లో కూడా అద్భుతంగా కాపునిచ్చే అత్యంత లాభదాయకమైన తోట.
risks: Fruit fly (Carpomyia vesuviana) — use bait sprays
Powdery mildew on developing young fruits
benefits: Thrives in extreme heat and saline soils where no other fruit survives
Apple Ber fetches ready local retail sales in winter

name: Betel Vine (Paan / Vilyadele)
confidenceNote: Mysore Chiguru GI betel leaf & Kumbakonam Vettrilai benchmarks.
harvestMonths: Weekly pickings starting 4 months after planting
rainfallMm: Shade thattlu / conservatory system with high humidity
spacing: Support live standards (Sesbania grandiflora) at 60 cm x 20 cm
fertilizerSchedule: Mustard/Neem cake + farmyard manure applied every 45 days.
harvestSigns: Glossy dark green leaves reach 12-15 cm length with crisp petioles.
storageAdvice: Pack in moist cloth and banana leaf baskets (Pindi of 100 leaves).
intercroppingOptions: Sesbania grandiflora standards (Agathi) also yield edible flowers
description: Betel Vine (Mysore Chiguru / Kumbakonam Vettrilai) is a high-skill, ultra high-return conservatory crop. Every week farmers pick thousands of leaves for daily temple and paan markets.
descriptionKn: ಮೈಸೂರು ಚಿಗುರೆಲೆಗೆ ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ (GI Tag) ಲಭಿಸಿದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ವಾರ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರ ನಗದು ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು.
descriptionTa: கும்பகோணம் வெற்றிலை உலகப் பிரசித்தி பெற்றது. வாரம் தோறும் பறித்து ஆண்டு முழுவதும் உச்ச லாபம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: తమలపాకు పూజలు, శుభకార్యాలకు అత్యంత పవిత్రమైన నిత్యావసర వాణిజ్య పంట.
risks: Foot rot / leaf rot (Phytophthora parasitica) in damp stagnant conditions
Bacterial leaf spot
benefits: Weekly liquid cash flow throughout the year
Mysore and Kumbakonam leaves command top market prestige

name: Bhendi (Okra / Ladyfinger)
confidenceNote: Standard ICAR/IIHR Bangalore package of practices (Arka Anamika / Radhika).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 40:20:20 kg N:P:K per acre (N in 3 splits).
harvestSigns: Pods are tender, 8-10 cm long, and the tips snap easily when bent.
storageAdvice: Pick every alternate day; transport in ventilated baskets.
description: Bhendi (Ladyfinger) is a fast cash-generating crop. First harvest begins in just 45 days and continues every 2 days for 2 months.
descriptionKn: ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಕೇವಲ 45 ದಿನದಲ್ಲೇ ಕೊಯ್ಲು ಶುರುವಾಗಿ, ದಿನಬಿಟ್ಟು ದಿನ ನಿರಂತರ ನಗದು ಆದಾಯ ತರುವ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: விதைத்த 45-வது நாளில் இருந்து 2 நாட்களுக்கு ஒரு முறை காய்க்கும் விரைவு பணப்பயிர்.
descriptionTe: విత్తిన 45 రోజుల నుంచే కాపు మొదలై ప్రతి రెండు రోజులకు నికర ఆదాయాన్నిచ్చే లాభదాయక పంట.
risks: Yellow Vein Mosaic Virus (YVMV) transmitted by whitefly
Fruit borer caterpillars
benefits: Harvest starts within 45 days of sowing
Continuous cash income every 2-3 days

name: Bitter Gourd (Hagalakayi)
confidenceNote: IIHR Bangalore package of practices (Arka Harit / Palee F1).
rainfallMm: Pandal or wire trellis with drip
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 40:30:30 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Tender dark or light green fruits before color changes to yellow.
storageAdvice: Pack in aerated crates; holds 3-4 days in shade.
description: Bitter gourd is celebrated for its blood sugar regulating properties, commanding steady health-conscious consumer demand year-round.
descriptionKn: ಮಧುಮೇಹ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಕ್ಕೆ ರಾಮಬಾಣವಾದ ಹಾಗಲಕಾಯಿಗೆ ವರ್ಷವಿಡೀ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಬೆಲೆಯಿದೆ.
descriptionTa: நீரிழிவு நோய்க்கு அருமருந்தான பாகற்காய் எப்போதும் நல்ல விலைக்கு விற்பனையாகும்.
descriptionTe: ఆరోగ్యానికి ఎంతో మేలు చేసే కాకరకాయ మార్కెట్లో స్థిరమైన డిమాండ్ కలిగి ఉంటుంది.
risks: Melon fruit fly (Bactrocera cucurbitae) laying eggs inside tender fruits
benefits: High medicinal value keeps prices resilient against market gluts
Pandal trellis yields heavy harvests for 2.5 months

name: Black Gram (Urad)
confidenceNote: Key rice-fallow pulse of Cauvery delta and Godavari delta (VBN 8 / LBG 752).
fertilizerSchedule: 10:20:10 kg N:P:K basal; in rice fallows, apply DAP 2% foliar spray at flowering.
harvestSigns: 85% pods turn deep black.
storageAdvice: Sun dry and mix with inert red earth or neem leaves.
description: Black gram (Urad/Uddina bele) is the essential ingredient for South Indian Idli and Dosa batter, ensuring year-round premium prices.
descriptionKn: ಇಡ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ದೋಸೆಗೆ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾದ ಉದ್ದು, ವರ್ಷವಿಡೀ ಭಾರಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.
descriptionTa: இட்லி, தோசை மாவுக்கு இன்றியமையாத உளுந்து. நெல் தரிசில் தூவி அதிக லாபம் ஈட்டலாம்.
descriptionTe: దక్షిణ భారతీయ అల్పాహారాలకు ప్రాణమైన మినుములు. వరి మాగాణుల్లో అతి తక్కువ ఖర్చుతో పండుతుంది.
risks: Yellow Mosaic Virus
Root rot in waterlogged clay
benefits: Top cash demand from restaurants and households
Broadcast directly into paddy stubbles with zero tillage

name: Black Pepper (King of Spices)
confidenceNote: Malnad & Western Ghats GI tagged Black Gold benchmarks (Panniyur 1 / Karimunda / Thevam).
seedRate: 400-500 rooted runner cuttings/acre (planted at base of areca or silver oak trees)
spacing: Trailed on arecanut / silver oak trees at 2.7m x 2.7m
fertilizerSchedule: 10 kg compost + 100g N, 40g P, 140g K per vine/year in 2 splits + Trichoderma harzianum.
harvestSigns: 1 or 2 berries in the spike turn bright orange-red.
storageAdvice: Dip spikes in boiling water for 1 minute and sun dry on clean mats for 7-10 days until berries turn wrinkled and black.
description: Black Pepper ("Black Gold") is the King of Spices. Trailed on arecanut palms or coffee shade trees, it requires no extra land and delivers pure bonus profit of ₹3-5 Lakhs per acre.
descriptionKn: ಅಡಿಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಸಿಲ್ವರ್ ಓಕ್ ಮರಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಾಳುಮೆಣಸನ್ನು ಹಬ್ಬಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಜಮೀನಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಎಕರೆಗೆ ₹3-5 ಲಕ್ಷ ಬೋನಸ್ ಲಾಭ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கருமிளகு "கருப்பு தங்கம்" என அழைக்கப்படுகிறது. பாக்கு மற்றும் காபி மரங்களில் ஏற்றி கூடுதல் நிலமின்றி அபார லாபம் ஈட்டலாம்.
descriptionTe: మిరియాలను నల్ల బంగారం అంటారు. పోక, కాఫీ చెట్లకు పాకించడం ద్వారా అదనపు ఖర్చు లేకుండా లక్షల లాభాలు పొందవచ్చు.
risks: Quick wilt / Foot rot (Phytophthora capsici) during heavy monsoons
Pollu beetle infesting spikes
benefits: Zero additional land needed when intercropped on arecanut or shade trees
International export commodity with spot cash liquidity

name: Bottle Gourd (Sorekayi)
confidenceNote: Standard riverbed and open field cucurbit package (Arka Bahar / Samrat).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 35:25:25 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Tender cylindrical green fruits with soft pubescence before shell hardens.
storageAdvice: Handle gently without bruising skin.
description: Bottle gourd is a high-yielding, cooling cucurbit vegetable that grows vigorously in river basins and irrigated plains.
descriptionKn: ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇಳುವರಿ ಕೊಡುವ ಸೋರೆಕಾಯಿ ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಿ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: குறைந்த செலவில் அதிக எடையுள்ள காய்களை தரும் சுரைக்காய் சிறந்த கோடை பயிர்.
descriptionTe: భారీ దిగుబడినిచ్చే సొరకాయ తక్కువ పెట్టుబడితో అధిక రాబడినిస్తుంది.
risks: Powdery mildew in dry spells
Fruit rot in waterlogged plots
benefits: Enormous tonnage per acre (15+ tonnes)
Low pest management expenditure

name: Brinjal (Eggplant / Aubergine)
confidenceNote: Standard UAS Bangalore and TNAU vegetable package of practices (Mattugulla GI / Arka Anand).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 50:35:35 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Fruits reach full glossy color before seeds harden and skin turns dull.
storageAdvice: Market fresh within 2-3 days.
description: Brinjal is a heavy yielder and everyday vegetable across South India, with cherished regional varieties like Udupi Mattu Gulla.
descriptionKn: ಉಡುಪಿ ಮಟ್ಟುಗುಳ್ಳ ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ ವೈವಿಧ್ಯಮಯ ಬದನೆಗೆ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಾದ್ಯಂತ ಭಾರಿ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಇದೆ.
descriptionTa: கத்தரிக்காய் அன்றாட சமையலில் தவிர்க்க முடியாத முக்கிய காய்கறி. தொடர் வருமானம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: వంకాయ కూరగాయల రారాజు. దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలో నిరంతర ఆదాయాన్నిచ్చే పంట.
risks: Shoot and fruit borer (Leucinodes orbonalis)
Bacterial wilt in infected soils
benefits: Harvest every 3-4 days for up to 90 days
Thrives across diverse soil profiles

name: Cabbage
confidenceNote: Chikkaballapur, Kolar, Belagavi and Nilgiris benchmarks (Golden Acre / Quisto / Pride of India).
spacing: 45 cm x 45 cm or 60 cm x 45 cm
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 60:40:40 kg N:P:K per acre (N in 3 splits).
harvestSigns: Heads are firm, compact, and solid when pressed with hand.
storageAdvice: Pack in ventilated gunny bags; holds 2-3 weeks at 2-5°C.
description: Cabbage is a heavy-yielding cool-season brassica with massive food-service and street-food demand across South Indian cities.
descriptionKn: ಎಲೆಕೋಸು ಕೇವಲ 80 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಎಕರೆಗೆ 20 ಟನ್ ಇಳುವರಿ ನೀಡುವ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ತರಕಾರಿ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: முட்டைக்கோஸ் அதிக எடையும் மகசூலும் தரும் குளிர்கால பணப்பயிர்.
descriptionTe: క్యాబేజీ అతి తక్కువ కాలంలో ఎకరానికి 15-20 టన్నుల భారీ దిగుబడినిచ్చే కూరగాయ.
risks: Diamondback moth (Plutella xylostella) caterpillars (use pheromone traps)
Black rot
benefits: Massive tonnage per acre (20+ tonnes)
Ready wholesale buyers at every mandi

name: Cardamom (Queen of Spices)
confidenceNote: Idukki (Cardamom Hills) & Sakleshpur / Kodagu rainforest benchmarks (Njallani / Green Gold / Appangala 1).
rainfallMm: 1800-3500 mm with cool evergreen shade canopy
spacing: 2 m x 2 m under evergreen rainforest canopy
fertilizerSchedule: 10 tonnes compost + 30:30:60 kg N:P:K per acre in 3 splits + neem cake.
harvestSigns: Capsules are mature and plump with dark brown to black seeds inside.
storageAdvice: Cure in specialized wood/diesel curing kilns at 45-50°C for 24-30 hours to retain deep emerald green color.
description: Cardamom ("Queen of Spices") is India's crown jewel spice. Cultivated in the misty rainforests of the Western Ghats, high-grade bold green cardamom commands ₹1,500 to ₹3,000 per kg at the Spices Board auction.
descriptionKn: ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಘಟ್ಟಗಳ ಮಲೆನಾಡಿನ ರಾಣಿ. ಸಕಲೇಶಪುರ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಡಗಿನ ಹಸಿರು ಏಲಕ್ಕಿ ವಿಶ್ವದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ದುಬಾರಿ ಸಾಂಬಾರ ಪದಾರ್ಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದೆ.
descriptionTa: ஏலக்காய் "நறுமணப் பொருட்களின் அரசி". அடர்ந்த காடுகளின் நிழலில் விளையும் பச்சை ஏலக்காய் சர்வதேச ஏலங்களில் உச்சபட்ச விலை பெறும்.
descriptionTe: యాలకులు సుగంధ ద్రవ్యాల రాణి. పశ్చిమ కనుమల శీతల వాతావరణంలో పండే యాలకులకు మార్కెట్లో అత్యంత ఖరీదైన ధర పలుకుతుంది.
risks: Katte / Mosaic virus transmitted by aphids
Thrips causing rough scurf on capsules reducing export grade
benefits: One of the most valuable agricultural commodities per kg on earth (₹1,500-₹3,000/kg)
Spices Board regulated electronic auctions guarantee transparent payments

name: Carrot
confidenceNote: Ooty (Nilgiris GI) and plains tropical carrot benchmarks (Kuroda / Pusa Rudhira / Super Kuroda).
rainfallMm: 400-600 mm on friable deep raised beds
spacing: 25 cm x 8 cm on raised beds
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 35:25:35 kg N:P:K per acre (potash gives rich orange color).
harvestSigns: Roots reach 15-20 cm with well-rounded tips and deep orange color.
storageAdvice: Wash in root washer, grade, and pack in net mesh bags; holds 10-15 days at 5°C.
description: Carrot is an exceptionally high-value root vegetable rich in beta-carotene. The Nilgiris (Ooty) produces world-famous sweet crisp carrots year-round.
descriptionKn: ಕ್ಯಾರೆಟ್ ವಿಟಮಿನ್ ಎ ಸಮೃದ್ಧವಾಗಿದ್ದು, ನೀಲಗಿರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬಯಲು ಸೀಮೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಆದಾಯ ತರುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: ஊட்டி கேரட் புவிசார் குறியீடு பெற்றது. வைட்டமின் ஏ நிறைந்த அதிக லாபகரமான பயிர்.
descriptionTe: క్యారెట్ పోషకాలు మెండుగా ఉండి మార్కెట్లో నిరంతరం మంచి ధర పలికే దుంప పంట.
risks: Root forking in heavy clay or stony soils
Sclerotinia rot in overly wet beds
benefits: Deep friable raised beds produce uniform export-grade roots
High year-round urban salad demand

name: Cashew
confidenceNote: Coastal Karnataka, Goa & Cuddalore/Vridhachalam cashew belt benchmarks (VRI 3 / Ullal 1 / Bhaskara).
seedRate: 80 grafted plants/acre (7m x 7m) or 160 plants (High Density 5m x 5m)
spacing: 7 m x 7 m or 5 m x 5 m
fertilizerSchedule: 15 kg FYM + 500g N, 125g P, 125g K per tree/year in August-September.
harvestSigns: Nuts turn grey and hard; cashew apples turn bright yellow or crimson red and drop naturally.
storageAdvice: Sun dry raw nuts for 3-4 days until moisture drops to 8-9% (nuts rattle inside shell).
description: Cashew thrives on barren, acidic laterite soils and coastal hills where nothing else grows, generating high-value export nuts with minimal water.
descriptionKn: ಬಂಜರು ಮತ್ತು ಕರಾವಳಿಯ ಜಂಬಿಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಗೇರು, ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ವೆಚ್ಚದಲ್ಲಿ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ಲಾಭ ತರುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: முந்திரி தரிசு நிலங்களிலும் செழித்து வளரும். உரிக்கப்படாத கொட்டைகள் சர்வதேச சந்தையில் அதிக விலை பெறும்.
descriptionTe: జీడిమామిడి చౌడు, ఎర్ర నేలల్లో కూడా తక్కువ నీటితో అద్భుతంగా కాపునిచ్చే ఎగుమతి తోట.
risks: Tea Mosquito Bug (Helopeltis antonii) drying out shoots and inflorescence
Stem and root borer (Plocaederus ferrugineus)
benefits: Thrives on degraded acidic laterite soils unsuitable for regular farming
Huge domestic and export kernel demand with high prices

name: Castor (Industrial Oil)
confidenceNote: High-value industrial lubricant and aviation oil crop (DCH 177 / DCH 519 / GCH 7).
spacing: 120 cm x 60 cm or 150 cm x 90 cm
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 4 tonnes + 30:15:15 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Spikes turn light brown and capsules dry up.
storageAdvice: Sun dry capsules and thresh; dry seeds store for 2 years without deterioration.
description: Castor is India's global export champion in industrial lubricants, aircraft greases, and cosmetics. Extremely deep-rooted and cattle-proof (livestock do not graze it).
descriptionKn: ಹರಳು ಬೆಳೆಯು ಬರಪೀಡಿತ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳ ರಕ್ಷಕ. ಜಾನುವಾರುಗಳು ಇದನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುವುದಿಲ್ಲವಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೇಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೂ ಸೂಕ್ತ.
descriptionTa: ஆமணக்கு கால்நடைகள் மேயாத, வறட்சியை தாங்கும் மிகச்சிறந்த தொழில்துறை எண்ணெய் பயிர்.
descriptionTe: ఆముదం పశువులు మేయని, అతి తక్కువ ఖర్చుతో ఎర్ర నేలల్లో పండే అత్యుత్తమ వాణిజ్య పంట.
risks: Castor semilooper caterpillar
Botrytis grey rot during prolonged wet monsoon
benefits: Zero livestock grazing hazard (natural ricin toxin protects crop)
Dominates global industrial lubricant exports

name: Cauliflower
confidenceNote: Bangalore rural and Nilgiris commercial cauliflower benchmarks (Pusa Deepali / Megha / Snowball).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 60:40:40 kg N:P:K + Boron 2 kg/acre (prevents brown curds).
harvestSigns: Curds are compact, pure white, and firm before branches begin to loosen.
storageAdvice: Retain 2-3 jacket leaves to protect the delicate white curd from sun tanning during transport.
description: Cauliflower is a premium brassica fetching top prices in winter and festival seasons. Blanching produces spotless milk-white curds for hotel supply.
descriptionKn: ಹೂಕೋಸು ಹೋಟೆಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾರಂಭಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗುವ ಲಾಭದಾಯಕ ತರಕಾರಿ.
descriptionTa: காலிஃபிளவர் குளிர்காலத்தில் சந்தையில் மிக அதிக விலைக்கு விற்பனையாகும் பிரீமியம் காய்கறி.
descriptionTe: కాలీఫ్లవర్ శీతాకాలంలో మార్కెట్లో అత్యధిక గిరాకీ ఉండే లాభదాయక పంట.
risks: Whip tail if Molybdenum is deficient in acidic soils
Diamondback moth
benefits: High individual curd prices (₹20-₹40 per head)
Quick 80-day turnover

name: Chickpea (Bengal Gram / Chana)
confidenceNote: Premier Rabi pulse of Deccan vertisols (JG 11 / JAKI 9218).
rainfallMm: Residual soil moisture in black soil
fertilizerSchedule: 10:20:10 kg N:P:K + Rhizobium + PSB biofertilizers.
harvestSigns: Plants dry up, turn yellow-brown, and pods shake loose inside.
storageAdvice: Sun dry to 10% moisture and store with 1% neem oil coating.
description: Bengal gram is the premier winter pulse of black cotton soils, thriving on residual moisture with zero irrigation in normal years.
descriptionKn: ಹಿಂಗಾರು ಹಂಗಾಮಿನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕಪ್ಪು ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಬೆಳೆ. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲೂ ಬಂಪರ್ ಇಳುವರಿ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கொண்டைக்கடலை குளிர்கால கரிசல் நில பயிராகும். குறைந்த பாசனத்தில் அதிக லாபம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: రబీ నల్లరేగడి నేలల్లో తేమను ఉపయోగించుకుని పెరిగే ప్రధాన పప్పు పంట.
risks: Pod borer larvae attack on developing green pods
Wilt and dry root rot in hot spells
benefits: Grows purely on residual moisture without irrigation
High market price and government MSP procurement

name: Chilli (Green / Dry)
confidenceNote: Byadagi GI tagged dry chilli and Guntur red chilli benchmarks (Byadagi Dabbi / Teja).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 60:40:40 kg N:P:K per acre (apply N in 4 splits).
harvestSigns: Pick green chillies at full size and firmness, or ripe red for drying.
storageAdvice: Sun dry red chillies on clean tarpaulins until moisture reaches 10% (pods crackle when pressed).
description: Chilli is a high-value spice-vegetable. Karnataka's Byadagi (famous for deep red color and low pungency) and Andhra's Guntur (pungent) dominate global markets.
descriptionKn: ಬ್ಯಾಡಗಿ ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿಗೆ ಅಂತಾರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಮನ್ನಣೆಯಿದೆ. ಹಸಿರು ಮತ್ತು ಒಣ ಮೆಣಸಿನಕಾಯಿ ಎರಡೂ ಭಾರಿ ಲಾಭ ತರುತ್ತವೆ.
descriptionTa: மிளகாய் முக்கிய வணிக பணப்பயிராகும். வற்றலாகவும் பச்சை மிளகாயாகவும் சந்தையில் எப்போதும் நல்ல விலை உண்டு.
descriptionTe: గుంటూరు మిర్చి దేశంలోనే ప్రసిద్ధి. ఎరుపు మిరప ఎగుమతులతో రైతులకు కాసుల వర్షం కురిపిస్తుంది.
risks: Thrips and Mites causing leaf curl (Murda disease)
Die-back and fruit rot (Anthracnose) in rainy spells
benefits: Continuous weekly harvest for 3-4 months
Byadagi varieties fetch GI premium price in domestic and export markets

name: Chrysanthemum (Sevanthige / Samanthi)
confidenceNote: Premier autumn and winter garland flower of Bangalore and Salem belts (Co 1 / Indira / Marigold Yellow).
spacing: 30 cm x 30 cm on raised beds
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 50:40:40 kg N:P:K per acre (pinch at 4 weeks to induce 15-20 flowering stems).
harvestSigns: Fully opened bright yellow or white flowers.
storageAdvice: Pack in aerated bamboo baskets; market within 24 hours.
description: Chrysanthemum (Sevanthige/Samanthi) is the backbone of the South Indian flower garland industry during the festive wedding season from October to January.
descriptionKn: ದಸರಾ ಮತ್ತು ಮದುವೆ ಸೀಸನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇವಂತಿಗೆಗೆ ಭಾರಿ ಬೆಲೆಯಿದ್ದು, ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಲಾಭ ತಂದುಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: சாமந்தி திருவிழாக்கள் மற்றும் திருமண சீசனில் உச்சக்கட்ட விலை பெறும் முக்கிய மலர் பயிர்.
descriptionTe: చామంతి శీతాకాలంలో పెళ్లిళ్లు, పూజల కోసం అపారమైన డిమాండ్ ఉన్న లాభసాటి పూల తోట.
risks: Thrips and aphids causing discoloration
Septoria leaf spot during humid weather
benefits: Extremely high wedding market demand in Nov-Jan
Multiple pickings over 45 days

name: Cluster Bean (Gorikayi / Kothavarai)
confidenceNote: Drought-hardy guar gum and vegetable pod legume (Pusa Navbahar / MDU 1).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 4 tonnes + 10:20:10 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Tender light green pods picked in clusters before seeds swell.
storageAdvice: Pack in aerated bags; pick every 3 days.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 30 - 45 Quintals fresh pods or 6-8 quintals dry guar seed
description: Cluster bean (Gorikayi) is a tough, deep-rooted dryland vegetable that thrives in high heat and saline-alkali soils with minimal inputs.
descriptionKn: ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ಉಷ್ಣಾಂಶವನ್ನು ತಡೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಅಗ್ಗದ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಗೋರಿಕಾಯಿ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: குறைந்த நீரில் அதிக மகசூல் தரும் பாரம்பரிய கொத்தவரங்காய்.
descriptionTe: గోరుచిక్కుడు ఎండలను తట్టుకుని తక్కువ ఖర్చుతో చేతికొచ్చే పౌష్టిక కూరగాయ.
risks: Bacterial blight in damp cloudy spells
benefits: Tolerates salinity and drought effortlessly
Fixes nitrogen and improves soil tilth

name: Coconut (Kalpavriksha)
confidenceNote: Arasikere, Tiptur (Copra GI), Pollachi & East Godavari coconut capital benchmarks (West Coast Tall / DxD / TxD).
spacing: 7.5 m x 7.5 m (25 ft x 25 ft)
fertilizerSchedule: 50 kg FYM + 500g N, 320g P, 1200g K + 1 kg Magnesium Sulphate per palm/year in 2 splits.
harvestSigns: Tender coconut: 7 months old with sweet water and jelly; Dry coconut/copra: 11-12 months old when outer husk turns brown.
storageAdvice: Store unhusked nuts in dry sheds; cup copra dried to 6% moisture.
description: Coconut (Kalpavriksha) is the legendary tree of heaven. Tiptur and Pollachi tender nuts and ball copra generate steady monthly cash flow for up to 80 years.
descriptionKn: ತಿಪಟೂರು ತೆಂಗಿಗೆ ವಿಶ್ವಮಾನ್ಯತೆಯಿದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ 45 ದಿನಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ ವರ್ಷಪೂರ್ತಿ ಮಾಸಿಕ ಪಿಂಚಣಿಯಂತೆ ಕೈತುಂಬ ಆದಾಯ ನೀಡುವ ಕಲ್ಪವೃಕ್ಷ.
descriptionTa: பொள்ளாச்சி இளநீர் மற்றும் கொப்பரை தென்னை விவசாயிகளுக்கு வாழ்நாள் முழுவதும் மாதாந்திர ஓய்வூதியம் போன்ற நிலையான வருவாய் தரும்.
descriptionTe: కొబ్బరిని కల్పవృక్షం అంటారు. తూర్పు గోదావరి, కోనసీమ ప్రాంతాల్లో తరతరాలకు నిరంతర నెలవారీ ఆదాయాన్నిచ్చే అమూల్యమైన పంట.
risks: Rhinoceros beetle and Red Palm Weevil damaging crown
Black headed caterpillar and Eriophyid mite
benefits: 60-80 years of monthly cash harvests
Tender water, copra, coir, and shells all have zero-waste commercial value

name: Coffee (Arabica / Robusta)
confidenceNote: Kodagu (Coorg), Chikkamagaluru & Hassan GI shade-grown coffee capital benchmarks (Selection 795 / Chandragiri / S.274).
waterMm: 1500-2500 mm (with summer blossom shower in March-April)
rainfallMm: 1500-2500 mm, shade-grown under two-tier forest canopy
spacing: 2 m x 2 m (Arabica) or 3 m x 3 m (Robusta)
fertilizerSchedule: 10 tonnes compost + 60:45:60 kg N:P:K/acre in 3 splits (pre-blossom, post-blossom, post-monsoon).
harvestSigns: Berries turn uniformly bright crimson red (fly picking, main picking, and strippings).
storageAdvice: Pulp and wash for parchment coffee, dry on tiled patios to 10.5% moisture; bag in clean grainpro bags.
intercroppingOptions: Black Pepper trailed on shade trees (Silver Oak / Erythrina)
description: Shade-grown Indian coffee from Coorg and Chikkamagaluru is world-famous. Intercropped with Black Pepper and Coorg Mandarin oranges, it forms a world-class agro-ecological system.
descriptionKn: ಕೊಡಗು, ಚಿಕ್ಕಮಗಳೂರಿನ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಬೆಳೆ. ನೆರಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಫಿ, ನೆರಳು ಮರಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಳುಮೆಣಸು, ನಡುವೆ ಕಿತ್ತಳೆ ಬೆಳೆದು ತ್ರಿವಳಿ ಆದಾಯ ಗಳಿಸಬಹುದು.
descriptionTa: ஏற்காடு, கொடைக்கானல் மலைகளில் விளையும் நறுமணமிக்க காபி மற்றும் மிளகு பண்ணைகள் மிகப்பெரிய ஏற்றுமதி சந்தை கொண்டவை.
descriptionTe: అరకు లోయ మరియు పశ్చిమ కనుమలలో పండే ప్రత్యేకమైన కాఫీ ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా గుర్తింపు పొందింది.
risks: Coffee White Stem Borer (Xylotrechus quadripes) in Arabica under poor shade
Coffee Leaf Rust (Hemileia vastatrix)
benefits: Export commodity with direct USD valuation
Combined with Black Pepper, revenue doubles on the same acre

name: Coleus (Makandi / Forskolin)
confidenceNote: Salem, Namakkal and Belagavi contract farming benchmarks for forskolin extraction (K-8 / Sudhira).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 20:30:40 kg N:P:K + Trichoderma harzianum.
harvestSigns: Leaves turn yellow and dry up; tubers develop deep yellow/orange aromatic flesh.
storageAdvice: Dig tubers, wash, slice into chips; sun dry to 8% moisture for pharmaceutical extraction.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 8 - 12 Quintals dried root chips/acre (approx. 4-6 tonnes wet tubers)
description: Coleus (Makandi) is grown exclusively for Forskolin, a bioactive alkaloid used worldwide for heart health, glaucoma, and fat-loss supplements. Extensively contract-farmed in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.
descriptionKn: ಫೋರ್ಸ್ಕೊಲಿನ್ ಅಂಶ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಮಕಂದಿ ಗಡ್ಡೆಯು ಹೃದಯದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಬ್ಬು ಕರಗಿಸುವ ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಔಷಧ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಭಾರಿ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ರಫ್ತಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: மருந்து கூர்க்கன் சர்வதேச மருந்து கம்பெனிகளால் நேரடியாக கொள்முதல் செய்யப்படும் பணப்பயிர்.
descriptionTe: కోలియస్ బరువు తగ్గే మరియు గుండె జబ్బుల మందుల తయారీకి అంతర్జాతీయంగా ఎగుమతి అయ్యే ఔషధ దుంప.
risks: Root-knot nematodes
Bacterial wilt in waterlogged soils (strict ridge-and-furrow planting required)
benefits: Guaranteed buy-back contracts with extraction companies
Thrives in dry red soils

name: Colocasia / Taro (Arbi / Keshavina Gaddi)
confidenceNote: Wetland and riverbank tuber crop of South India (Muktakeshi / Sree Kiran).
rainfallMm: 800-1500 mm in damp canal beds and wet plots
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 35:20:35 kg N:P:K per acre (earthing up at 45 and 90 days).
harvestSigns: Leaves turn yellow and dry up; corms bulge visibly below soil surface.
storageAdvice: Sun dry corms for 2 days; stores in ventilated bags for 2-3 months.
intercroppingOptions: Ideal companion for wet ditch borders and canal water channels
description: Colocasia (Seppankizhangu/Chamadumpa) produces crispy fried gourmet cormels and tender leaves used in South Indian delicacies (Patrode/Chembila curry).
descriptionKn: ಕರಾವಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಲೆನಾಡಿನ ಪತ್ರೊಡೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ ಕೇಶವಿನ ಗಡ್ಡೆ, ನೀರು ನಿಲ್ಲುವ ತಗ್ಗು ಜಮೀನಿಗೂ ಸೂಕ್ತ.
descriptionTa: சேப்பங்கிழங்கு வறுவலுக்கு பெயர் பெற்ற சுவையான கிழங்கு. ஈர நிலங்களில் மிக நன்றாக வளரும்.
descriptionTe: చామదుంప ఆంధ్రా ఇళ్లలో అమితంగా ఇష్టపడే దుంప కూరగాయ. మంచి మార్కెట్ ధర పలుకుతుంది.
risks: Phytophthora leaf blight during continuous monsoon drizzle
benefits: Both cormels and tender leaves are marketed for food
Grows in wet, low-lying plots where other crops rot

name: Coriander (Dhania / Kothambari)
confidenceNote: Dual purpose grain & green herb crop of Bellary, Dharwad and Virudhunagar.
seedRate: 5-6 kg/acre (split grains into two halves before sowing)
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 4 tonnes + 15:15:10 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Umbels turn brown and seeds rattle inside.
storageAdvice: Sun dry on tarpaulin to 9% moisture; store in airtight gunny bags to retain aromatic linalool oil.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 4 - 7 Quintals grain or 25-30 quintals fresh green leaves
intercroppingOptions: Intercrop with Bengal gram or safflower
description: Coriander is a versatile short-duration crop grown for fragrant fresh garnish leaves (35 days) or aromatic spice seeds (80 days) on black vertisols.
descriptionKn: ಕೊತ್ತಂಬರಿಯು ಕೇವಲ 35 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹಸಿರು ಸೊಪ್ಪಾಗಿಯೂ, 80 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಂಬಾರ ಬೀಜವಾಗಿಯೂ (ಧನಿಯಾ) ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಲಾಭ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கொத்தமல்லி தழையாகவும் விதையாகவும் பயன்படும் குறுகிய கால நறுமணப் பயிர்.
descriptionTe: కొత్తిమీర ఆకుగాను, ధనియాలుగాను ఉపయోగపడే అతి స్వల్పకాలిక లాభసాటి పంట.
risks: Powdery mildew during winter mists
Wilt
benefits: Ready as green leaf herb in just 35 days
Low water and input costs

name: Cotton (White Gold)
confidenceNote: Raichur, Dharwad, Bellary and Coimbatore textile belt benchmarks (Bt Cotton / RCH 2 / Bunny).
rainfallMm: 600-900 mm or furrow irrigation in deep black soils
spacing: 90 cm x 60 cm or 120 cm x 45 cm
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 5 tonnes + 60:30:30 kg N:P:K per acre (split N at 30, 60, and 90 days; foliar Boron & MgSO4).
harvestSigns: Bolls burst open fully revealing white fluffy lint; pick in morning hours after dew dries.
storageAdvice: Sun dry raw cotton (Kapas) to below 8% moisture; store in dry rodent-proof godowns.
intercroppingOptions: Green gram or soybean (1:2 ratio) during early growth
description: Cotton is the "White Gold" of North Karnataka and Telangana black soils, feeding the spinning mills of Coimbatore and Surat.
descriptionKn: ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಕಪ್ಪು ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಬಿಳಿ ಬಂಗಾರ. ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಗಿರಣಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಚ್ಚಾವಸ್ತು ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: பருத்தி ஜவுளி ஆலைகளுக்கு உயிர்நாடியான "வெள்ளை தங்கம்". அதிக ஏற்றுமதி மதிப்பு கொண்டது.
descriptionTe: ప్రత్తి తెలంగాణ మరియు రాయలసీమ రైతుల తెల్ల బంగారం. పత్తి మిల్లుల ద్వారా నేరుగా నగదు చేకూరుతుంది.
risks: Pink bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella) in late picking stages
Sucking pests (thrips, jassids, whitefly) in early 60 days
benefits: Global commodity with competitive open mandi bidding and CCI procurement
Thrives in heavy black cotton vertisols with high moisture retention

name: Cowpea (Alasande / Karamani)
confidenceNote: Standard dual-purpose grain and green manure crop.
fertilizerSchedule: 10:20:10 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Pods turn light yellow-brown and seeds bulge.
storageAdvice: Sun dry and mix with wood ash to prevent weevils.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 5 - 8 Quintals grain or 15 quintals green pods
description: Cowpea is a versatile dual-purpose legume, grown for tender vegetable pods, dry protein-rich grains, and nutritious cattle forage.
descriptionKn: ಅಲಸಂದೆಯು ಕಾಯಿ ತರಕಾರಿಗೂ ಮತ್ತು ಒಣ ಧಾನ್ಯಕ್ಕೂ ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಸೈ ಎನಿಸುವ ಬಹುಪಯೋಗಿ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: காராமணி பசுங்காயாகவும் உலர் பயறாகவும் பயன்படும் அதிக புரதம் கொண்ட பயறு.
descriptionTe: బొబ్బర్లు కూరగాయగా మరియు పప్పుగా ఉపయోగపడే బహుముఖ ప్రయోజనకర పంట.
risks: Aphids on tender shoots and flower clusters
benefits: Quick ground cover suppresses weeds completely
Fixes nitrogen rapidly

name: Crossandra (Kanakambaram)
confidenceNote: Indigenous coastal and plains high-value flower (Arka Ambara / Arka Kanaka / Delhi Crossandra).
harvestMonths: Starts 60 days after transplanting and continues year-round
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 40:20:20 kg N:P:K per acre/year.
harvestSigns: Bright orange/red flowers picked every alternate day before noon.
storageAdvice: Pack in wet cloth lined cane baskets; market on same day.
description: Crossandra (Kanakambaram) commands the highest price per kilogram among traditional flowers (₹400-₹1500/kg). Pairs traditionally with Jasmine in South Indian hair adornment.
descriptionKn: ಹೂವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ದುಬಾರಿ ಬೆಲೆ (ಕೆಜಿಗೆ ₹500-₹1500) ಬಾಳುವ ಕನಕಾಂಬರವು ಸಣ್ಣ ಹಿಡುವಳಿದಾರರಿಗೆ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: கனகாம்பரம் மல்லிகையோடு சேர்த்து கட்டப்படும் மிக அதிக விலை போகும் பாரம்பரிய மலர்.
descriptionTe: కనకాంబరాలు కేజీ రూ. 500 నుంచి రూ. 1500 వరకు పలికే అత్యంత ఖరీదైన పూల పంట.
risks: Fusarium wilt combined with nematode infestation
benefits: Highest per-kg flower price in Indian markets
Continuous harvest every 48 hours for 2 years

name: Cucumber (Southekayi)
confidenceNote: Salad and sambar dosakaya cultivars (Poinsette / Arka Sheetal / Guntur Yellow).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 6 tonnes + 30:20:20 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Tender crisp green fruits (or yellow firm skin for Andhra cooking dosakaya).
storageAdvice: Market fresh within 3-4 days.
description: Cucumber is a lightning-fast 70-day cash crop with massive urban demand for summer salads, raita, and Andhra sambar dosakaya.
descriptionKn: ಕೇವಲ 70 ದಿನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಸೌತೆಕಾಯಿ ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ನಗದು ತಂದುಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கோடையில் தாகம் தீர்க்கும் வெள்ளரி மிக குறுகிய காலத்தில் அறுவடை தரும்.
descriptionTe: దోసకాయ ఆంధ్రా వంటకాల్లో ప్రముఖమైనది. అతి తక్కువ రోజుల్లో చేతికొచ్చే పంట.
risks: Fruit fly
Powdery mildew
benefits: 70-day cycle enables multiple rotations per year
High summer water-content salad demand

name: Custard Apple / Seethaphal
confidenceNote: Dharur & Mahabubnagar wild hill and orchard custard apple benchmarks (Balanagar / Arka Sahan / NMK-1 Golden).
fertilizerSchedule: 15 kg FYM + 200g N, 100g P, 200g K per tree annually.
harvestSigns: Segments between skin areoles widen and turn creamy white/yellowish.
storageAdvice: Pack in single layer cushioned boxes; ripens in 2-3 days.
intercroppingOptions: Pulses and pasture grasses in early years
description: Custard Apple (Seethaphal) is nature's dessert fruit. Animals will not touch its leaves or branches, making it the supreme choice for unfenced dry hills and rocky soils.
descriptionKn: ಸೀತಾಫಲವನ್ನು ಆಡು, ಕುರಿ, ದನಗಳು ಮುಟ್ಟುವುದಿಲ್ಲವಾದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬೇಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲದ ಬಂಜರು ಜಮೀನಿಗೂ ಸೂಕ್ತ.
descriptionTa: சீத்தாப்பழம் கால்நடைகள் மேயாத, பாறை நிலங்களிலும் செழித்து வளரும் சுவையான பழப்பயிர்.
descriptionTe: సీతాఫలం పశువులు మేయని, రాతి నేలల్లో కూడా అత్యంత రుచికరమైన పండ్లను ఇచ్చే తోట.
risks: Mealybugs on developing fruit clusters (use Cryptolaemus predator beetles)
benefits: Zero grazing damage from cattle, goats, or wild boars
High demand from premium ice cream and pulp processing companies

name: Drumstick (Moringa)
confidenceNote: TNAU Coimbatore annual moringa benchmarks (PKM 1 / PKM 2 / ODC 3).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 15 kg/tree + 100:100:100g N:P:K per tree after annual pruning.
harvestSigns: Pods reach 45-60 cm length with tender flesh and fleshy seeds before fiber develops.
storageAdvice: Tie in bundles of 50 pods; keeps fresh for 4-5 days under cool conditions.
description: Drumstick (Moringa) is South India's undisputed green gold. Annual varieties like PKM-1 produce pods in 6 months with minimal water and high export demand.
descriptionKn: ನುಗ್ಗೆಕಾಯಿಯು ಕಡಿಮೆ ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಷವಿಡೀ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ಆದಾಯ ನೀಡುವ ಕಲ್ಪವೃಕ್ಷ ತರಕಾರಿ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: முருங்கை குறைந்த நீரில் ஆண்டு முழுவதும் அறுவடை தரும் அருமையான வணிக பயிர். ஏற்றுமதிக்கு மிகச் சிறந்தது.
descriptionTe: మునగ తక్కువ నీటితో ఏడాదంతా నిరంతర ఆదాయాన్నిచ్చే అమూల్యమైన కూరగాయ తోట.
risks: Pod fly (Gitona distigma) causing rotting of tender pods
Hairy caterpillars feeding on leaves
benefits: Harvest starts in 6 months and continues for 4-5 years
Moringa leaves also fetch premium price as nutritional superfood powder

name: Elephant Foot Yam (Suvarnagadde / Senai)
confidenceNote: Major cash tuber of Godavari basin and Cauvery delta (Gajendra variety).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 12 tonnes + 50:30:60 kg N:P:K per acre (applied in 3 splits).
harvestSigns: Pseudostem withers and falls flat to ground.
storageAdvice: Corms store fresh for 4 to 6 months in a dark dry room.
description: Elephant foot yam (Gajendra variety) is a massive commercial cash tuber yielding 20+ tonnes per acre with zero acridity and huge festive demand.
descriptionKn: ಸುವರ್ಣಗಡ್ಡೆಯ ಗಜೇಂದ್ರ ತಳಿಯು ಎಕರೆಗೆ 20 ಟನ್‌ಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇಳುವರಿ ನೀಡಿ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಲಾಭ ತರುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: சேனைக்கிழங்கு அதிக எடையும் மகசூலும் தரும் பணப்பயிர். விழா காலங்களில் மிக அதிக விலை பெறும்.
descriptionTe: కంద ఎకరానికి 20 టన్నుల వరకు దిగుబడినిచ్చే అత్యంత లాభదాయకమైన వాణిజ్య దుంప పంట.
risks: Collar rot in waterlogged plots
benefits: Huge yields (up to 25 tonnes/acre)
Can be left in soil for 2-3 months after maturity until market price rises

name: Fenugreek (Methi / Menthya)
confidenceNote: Dual purpose 25-day green herb and 90-day spice seed (Pusa Early Bunching / Lam Sel 1).
harvestMonths: 25 days for greens; 90 days for seeds
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 5 tonnes + 15:15:10 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Greens pulled out at 20-25 days when 10-15 cm tall with 3-4 leaves.
storageAdvice: Market fresh within 12 hours.
description: Fenugreek (Menthya/Vendhayam) is a multi-purpose herb. Harvested in just 25 days as a fragrant, blood-sugar lowering green leafy vegetable with huge urban sales.
descriptionKn: ಕೇವಲ 25 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಮೆಂತ್ಯ ಸೊಪ್ಪು ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ನಗದು ಆದಾಯ ತರುವ ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: வெந்தயக்கீரை 25 நாட்களில் அறுவடையாகும் உடலுக்கு குளிர்ச்சி தரும் பாரம்பரிய மூலிகைக் கீரை.
descriptionTe: మెంతికూర కేవలం 25 రోజుల్లో చేతికొచ్చే అత్యంత లాభదాయకమైన ఆకుకూర.
risks: Powdery mildew in cold cloudy weather
benefits: Lightning quick 25-day turnover
Fixes atmospheric nitrogen into the soil

name: Field Bean / Hyacinth Bean (Avare)
confidenceNote: Celebrated heritage winter pulse of Bangalore and Mysore regions (HA 4 / Hebbal Avare).
fertilizerSchedule: 10:25:15 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Pods turn plump with distinct aroma; seeds bulge visibly.
storageAdvice: Sell fresh pods immediately in peak winter festival season for top price.
potentialYieldPerAcre: 25 - 35 Quintals fresh pods or 6-8 quintals dry pulse
description: Field bean (Avarekalu/Mochai) is South Karnataka's beloved fragrant winter delicacy, commanding massive market premiums during winter festivals.
descriptionKn: ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು-ಮೈಸೂರು ಭಾಗದ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಅವರೆಕಾಳು. ಚಳಿಗಾಲದ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: மொச்சை குளிர்காலத்தில் அறுவடையாகும் நறுமணமிக்க பாரம்பரிய பயறு. சந்தையில் நல்ல விலை கிடைக்கும்.
descriptionTe: అనుములు శీతాకాలంలో పండే సువాసనభరితమైన విశిష్ట పప్పు పంట.
risks: Aphis craccivora (black bean aphids) on tender shoots and flowers
Pod borer
benefits: Massive profit when sold as fresh green pods in December-January
Traditional symbiotic intercrop with Ragi

name: Finger Millet (Ragi)
confidenceNote: Standard UAS Bangalore package of practices; premier drought-hardy nutritious cereal of Karnataka.
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 4 tonnes/acre + 40:20:20 N:P:K kg/acre (half N basal, remaining N at 30 days).
harvestSigns: Earheads turn brown and grains harden (cannot be split with fingernail).
storageAdvice: Ragi has excellent storage life (up to 5 years) in dry bins without pest infestation.
description: Finger millet is the climate-resilient superfood cereal of South Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, rich in calcium and dietary fiber.
descriptionKn: ರಾಗಿಯು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆಯ ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕ ಸಿರಿಧಾನ್ಯ. ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ ಮತ್ತು ನಾರಿನಂಶದಿಂದ ಸಮೃದ್ಧವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಬರವನ್ನು ಮೆಟ್ಟಿ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கேழ்வரகு வறட்சியை தாங்கி வளரும் ஊட்டச்சத்து மிக்க சிறுதானியமாகும். கால்சியம் மற்றும் நார்ச்சத்து மிகுந்தது.
descriptionTe: రాగులు పోషకాల గని అయిన చిరుధాన్యం. క్యాల్షియం సమృద్ధిగా ఉండి తక్కువ నీటితో అధిక దిగుబడినిస్తుంది.
risks: Blast disease during continuous monsoon mist
Stem borer at vegetative stage
benefits: Extremely climate-smart and drought-hardy
High retail market demand for health foods and diabetic diets
Nutritious livestock straw

name: Fodder Sorghum (Multicut CO-FS-29)
confidenceNote: TNAU multicut drought-tolerant fodder sorghum (CO-FS-29 / Co 31).
harvestMonths: First cut at 60 days, then every 45 days
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 6 tonnes + 35:20:15 kg N:P:K per acre (top dress 20 kg Urea after every cut).
harvestSigns: Harvest at 50% flowering (approx. 2m height) to ensure low HCN and high digestibility.
storageAdvice: Chop and feed or make silage in pits.
description: Multicut fodder sorghum (CO-FS-29) gives 5-6 lush cuts per year even in low rainfall drylands, relished by dairy cows for its sweet juicy stems.
descriptionKn: ಒಣಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲೂ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ 5-6 ಬಾರಿ ಸಮೃದ್ಧ ಹಸಿರು ಮೇವು ನೀಡುವ ಸಿಹಿ ಮೇವು ಜೋಳ.
descriptionTa: வறட்சியிலும் ஆண்டுக்கு 5-6 அறுவடைகள் தரும் சுவையான தீவன சோளம்.
descriptionTe: తక్కువ నీటితో ఏటా 5-6 కోతలు ఇచ్చే తీపి రసభరితమైన గడ్డి జొన్న.
risks: Young shoots under 40 days contain hydrocyanic acid (HCN); do not feed until plants reach 50 days of age
benefits: Drought-hardy multicut capability in vertisols
High palatability and sugar content

name: Foxtail Millet (Navane / Thinai)
confidenceNote: Standard UASB / TNAU minor millet package of practices.
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 2 tonnes + 16:8:8 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Earheads turn golden yellow and leaves dry up.
storageAdvice: Sun dry and de-husk before selling or store un-husked for 2+ years.
description: Ancient golden millet known as Navane in Kannada and Thinai in Tamil. Known for low glycemic index and high protein.
descriptionKn: ನವಣೆಯು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪುರಾತನ ಸಿರಿಧಾನ್ಯ. ರಕ್ತದಲ್ಲಿನ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಮಟ್ಟವನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ.
descriptionTa: தினை சங்க காலம் தொட்டு பயிரிடப்படும் பாரம்பரிய சத்துணவு சிறுதானியம். நீரிழிவுக்கு சிறந்தது.
descriptionTe: కొర్రలు రక్తంలో చక్కెర శాతాన్ని అదుపులో ఉంచే ప్రముఖ చిరుధాన్యం. సులభంగా జీర్ణమవుతుంది.
risks: Smut disease
Bird damage during grain maturity
benefits: Ready for harvest in just 80 days
Premium price in organic health food stores

name: French Bean (Huralikayi)
confidenceNote: Ooty and Bangalore plains bush and pole bean package (Arka Komal / Arka Suvidha).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 25:35:25 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Tender cylindrical green pods snap cleanly without stringiness.
storageAdvice: Pick every 2-3 days; transport in cool morning hours.
description: French beans are a top premium vegetable with high daily prices in South Indian metro markets, maturing in just 65 days.
descriptionKn: ಕೇವಲ 65 ದಿನದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಬೀನ್ಸ್ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸದಾ ಉತ್ತಮ ಬೆಲೆ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: குறுகிய காலத்தில் அறுவடை தரும் பீன்ஸ் காய்கறி சந்தையில் அதிக லாபம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: కేవలం 65 రోజుల్లో చేతికొచ్చే ఫ్రెంచ్ బీన్స్ మంచి మార్కెట్ ధరను కలిగి ఉంటుంది.
risks: Anthracnose fungus in continuous rains
Stem fly in early seedling stage
benefits: Fast 65-day crop turnover
Premium urban supermarket pricing

name: Garlic
confidenceNote: Ooty and Kodaikanal hill garlic GI benchmarks (G-1 / Ooty 1).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 40:25:25 kg N:P:K + Sulphur 20 kg/acre.
harvestSigns: Tops turn yellowish brown and dry out.
storageAdvice: Braid tops and hang in airy sheds or store on slatted shelves.
description: Garlic is a high-value spice-vegetable famous for medicinal allicin content. Hill garlic from Kodaikanal and Ooty commands premium prices.
descriptionKn: ಬೆಳ್ಳುಳ್ಳಿಯು ಔಷಧೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮಸಾಲೆ ಬೆಳೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲಿಕ ಶೇಖರಣಾ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.
descriptionTa: கொடைக்கானல் மலைப்பூண்டு புவிசார் குறியீடு பெற்றது. மிக அதிக மருத்துவ குணம் கொண்டது.
descriptionTe: వెల్లుల్లి అత్యధిక ఔషధ విలువలున్న వాణిజ్య పంట. మంచి మార్కెట్ ధర పలుకుతుంది.
risks: Stem and bulb nematode in damp soils
White rot
benefits: Long shelf life (6-8 months) allows holding for peak prices
Immense pharmaceutical and culinary demand

name: Ginger (Shunti / Inji)
confidenceNote: Shivamogga, Hassan, Kodagu and Wayanad ginger grower benchmarks (Varada / Maran / Mahim).
rainfallMm: 1200-1800 mm with heavy green leaf mulching
spacing: 30 cm x 25 cm on raised beds (15 cm high)
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 12 tonnes + 40:30:40 kg N:P:K + 3 rounds of green leaf mulch (10 tonnes total).
harvestSigns: Leaves turn dry, yellow, and pseudostems lodge.
storageAdvice: Sell fresh for culinary markets or dry into Sonth (dry ginger) after peeling and liming.
intercroppingOptions: Intercrop under young areca or coconut orchards
description: Ginger is one of the highest cash-generating crops per acre in South India. Multi-ton yields under green leaf mulching create record profits in Hassan and Wayanad.
descriptionKn: ಶುಂಠಿಯು ಹಾಸನ, ಶಿವಮೊಗ್ಗ ಭಾಗದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಹಣದ ಬೆಳೆ. ಹಸಿಶುಂಠಿ ಮತ್ತು ಒಣಶುಂಠಿ (ಸೊಂಠಿ) ಎರಡರಲ್ಲೂ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ಲಾಭ.
descriptionTa: இஞ்சி மிக அதிக லாபம் தரும் நறுமண பணப்பயிர். பசுந்தாள் மூடாக்கு போட்டு சாகுபடி செய்தால் அபார மகசூல்.
descriptionTe: అల్లం అతి తక్కువ విస్తీర్ణంలో అత్యధిక లాభాలు తెచ్చే సుగంధ ద్రవ్య పంట.
risks: Soft rot / Rhizome rot (Pythium / Ralstonia solanacearum) — requires clean seed and bio-control
Shoot borer
benefits: Extraordinary cash revenue (₹3-5 Lakhs/acre)
High demand in beverage, tea, culinary, and pharmaceutical sectors

name: Green Gram (Moong)
confidenceNote: Short-duration catch pulse across South India (KKM 3 / DGGV 2).
fertilizerSchedule: 10:20:10 kg N:P:K + Rhizobium seed inoculation.
harvestSigns: Pods turn black and crisp.
storageAdvice: Pick pods in 2 rounds as they mature; dry to 9% moisture.
description: Green gram (Moong) is the fastest cash-yielding pulse, maturing in just 60 days. Excellent as a soil-enriching summer catch crop.
descriptionKn: ಕೇವಲ 60 ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವ ಸೂಪರ್ ಬೆಳೆ. ಭೂಮಿಗೆ ಫಲವತ್ತತೆ ತಂದುಕೊಡಲು ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ.
descriptionTa: 60 நாட்களில் அறுவடை தரும் அருமையான குறுகிய கால பயறு. கோடை உழவுக்கு சிறந்தது.
descriptionTe: కేవలం 60 రోజుల్లో చేతికొచ్చే శ్రేష్టమైన స్వల్పకాలిక పంట. భూసారాన్ని పెంచుతుంది.
risks: Yellow Mosaic Virus transmitted by whiteflies
Powdery mildew in winter
benefits: 60-day turnover allows 3 crops a year
Restores soil nitrogen and organic matter

name: Groundnut (Peanut)
confidenceNote: Chitradurga, Tumakuru, Anantapur & Villupuram rainfed groundnut heartland (TMV 2 / Kadiri 6 / KCG 6).
rainfallMm: 500-750 mm on well-drained friable red sandy loams
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 5 tonnes + 10:20:15 kg N:P:K + Gypsum 150 kg/acre at peg penetration (Day 40-45).
harvestSigns: Leaves turn yellow and drop; inside of shell develops dark brown/black netting.
storageAdvice: Sun dry pods to below 8% moisture (pod rattles loudly when shaken); store unhusked in aerated bags.
description: Groundnut is South India's primary oilseed and soil-enriching legume. Anantapur and Chitradurga produce millions of tons of cold-pressed oil nuts and export kernels.
descriptionKn: ಚಿತ್ರದುರ್ಗ ಮತ್ತು ತುಮಕೂರಿನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಎಣ್ಣೆಕಾಳು ಬೆಳೆ. ಗಿಪ್ಸಮ್ ಬಳಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಕಾಯಿ ಕಟ್ಟುವಿಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ಇಳುವರಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: நிலக்கடலை தமிழகத்தின் முதன்மை எண்ணெய் வித்து பயிராகும். ஜிப்சம் இடுவதால் திரட்சியான பருப்புகள் உருவாகும்.
descriptionTe: అనంతపురం జిల్లా వేరుశనగ సాగుకు దేశంలోనే ప్రసిద్ధి. రైజోబియం మరియు జిప్సమ్‌తో బంపర్ దిగుబడి సాధ్యం.
risks: Tikka leaf spot (Cercospora arachidicola) in damp overcast weather
Spodoptera caterpillar and white grub damaging subterranean pods
benefits: Fixes massive nitrogen and leaves land fertile for following cereal
High market liquidity with APMC MSP procurement

name: Guava (Taiwan Pink / Lucknow 49)
confidenceNote: Meadow orchard and High Density Guava package (Taiwan Pink / L-49 / Arka Kiran).
seedRate: 600-800 layered/grafted plants/acre (Meadow Orchard: 2m x 2m or 3m x 2m)
spacing: 3 m x 2 m (UHDP) or 5 m x 5 m (traditional)
fertilizerSchedule: 20 kg FYM + 250g N, 150g P, 250g K per plant/year + Zinc & Boron spray.
harvestSigns: Dark green skin changes to light greenish yellow.
storageAdvice: Pack in foam fruit sleeves; stores for 7-10 days in cool storage.
intercroppingOptions: Legumes and vegetables during first 2 years
description: Guava (Taiwan Pink / L-49) is a beginner farmer's dream fruit orchard. Highly tolerant of drought and salinity, begins commercial bearing in just 18 months.
descriptionKn: ತೈವಾನ್ ಪಿಂಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಲಕ್ನೋ-49 ಸೀಬೆ ಕೇವಲ ಒಂದೂವರೆ ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲೇ ಫಸಲು ನೀಡುವ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಹಣ್ಣಿನ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: தைவான் பிங்க் கொய்யா நடவு செய்த 18 மாதங்களில் பலன் தரும். வறட்சியை தாங்கி அதிக லாபம் ஈட்டும்.
descriptionTe: తైవాన్ జామ నాటిన ఏడాదిన్నర నుంచే కాపుకొస్తుంది. తక్కువ నీటితో అద్భుతమైన రాబడి.
risks: Fruit fly (Bactrocera correcta) in rainy season (use pheromone traps)
Guava wilt in waterlogged soils
benefits: Begins bearing within 15-18 months of planting
Tolerates soil salinity and pH up to 8.5 where other fruits fail

name: Hedge Lucerne / Velimasal
confidenceNote: TNAU multi-cut perennial high-protein legume forage (Velimasal / CO 1).
harvestMonths: First cut at 70 days, then every 35-40 days
seedRate: 6-8 kg/acre (acid or hot water scarified seeds)
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 5 tonnes + 10:25:10 kg N:P:K per acre annually.
harvestSigns: Cut at 45-50 cm height when flowering begins.
storageAdvice: Feed fresh mixed with cereal straw or dry into protein leaf meal.
description: Hedge Lucerne (Velimasal) is a perennial multi-cut legume fodder containing 20-22% crude protein. Replaces expensive oil cakes and concentrates in dairy and goat farming.
descriptionKn: ಶೇ 22% ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಬಹು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ದ್ವಿದಳ ಮೇವು. ಹಸು ಮತ್ತು ಕುರಿ-ಮೇಕೆಗಳ ತೂಕ ಹಾಗೂ ಹಾಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: 22% புரதம் கொண்ட வேலிமசால் கறவை மாடுகள் மற்றும் ஆடுகளுக்கு மிகச்சிறந்த அடர் தீவன மாற்றாகும்.
descriptionTe: 22 శాతం ప్రొటీన్ కలిగిన విశిష్ట పశుగ్రాసం. పాడి ఆవులు మరియు గొర్రెలు, మేకల పెంపకానికి అత్యుత్తమ ఆహారం.
risks: Hard seed coat requires hot water scarification before sowing
benefits: 20-22% high crude protein
Non-bloating and safe for cattle, sheep, and goats

name: Horse Gram (Hurali / Kollu)
confidenceNote: Ultimate drought-resilient pulse of South Karnataka and Tamil Nadu (PHG 9 / CRIDA 18R).
fertilizerSchedule: 10:15:0 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Vines turn straw colored and pods turn dry parchment yellow.
storageAdvice: Sun dry and bag in moisture-free bins.
description: Horse gram (Hurali/Kollu/Ulavalu) is the hardiest legume known, thriving on barren, gravelly soils where no other crop can survive.
descriptionKn: ಬಂಜರು ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲೂ ಬಂಗಾರದಂತೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕ ಬೆಳೆ. ತೂಕ ಇಳಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ರೋಗನಿರೋಧಕ ಶಕ್ತಿಗೆ ರಾಮಬಾಣ.
descriptionTa: கொள்ளு வறட்சியிலும் விளையும் இரும்புச்சத்து மிக்க பாரம்பரிய பயறு. கொழுப்பை கரைக்கும் அற்புத உணவு.
descriptionTe: ఉలవలు అత్యంత పోషక విలువలున్న పప్పు ధాన్యం. తీవ్రమైన కరవును కూడా తట్టుకుంటుంది.
risks: Anthracnose in wet conditions
benefits: Zero pest pressure
Best crop for broken stones and shallow gravel soils
Foliage makes super-rich fodder

name: Jackfruit (All Season / Tubagere)
confidenceNote: Tubagere (Karnataka) & Panruti (Tamil Nadu) GI jackfruit benchmarks (Siddu / Swarna).
spacing: 9 m x 9 m or field borders
fertilizerSchedule: 30 kg FYM + 250g N, 150g P, 250g K per mature tree annually.
harvestSigns: Spines become widely spaced and blunt; fruit emits sweet aroma; hollow thud sound when tapped.
storageAdvice: Keeps fresh for 4-6 days after harvesting.
description: Jackfruit (Panruti/Tubagere) is South India's powerhouse border and intercrop tree. Emerging as the world's leading plant-based meat alternative with zero chemical spray requirements.
descriptionKn: ತುಬಗೆರೆ ಹಲಸು ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಂಪು ತೊಳೆ ಸಿದ್ದು ಹಲಸು ಯಾವುದೇ ಕ್ರಿಮಿನಾಶಕವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ ತರುವ ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: பண்ருட்டி பலாப்பழம் உலகளவில் பெயர் பெற்றது. எந்த பராமரிப்பும் இன்றி தலைமுறைக்கும் வருமானம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: పనస పండు సహజసిద్ధంగా ఎలాంటి మందులు లేకుండా ఏటా భారీగా కాపునిచ్చే లాభదాయక చెట్టు.
risks: Fruit rot (Rhizopus artocarpi) during heavy monsoon
benefits: Zero pesticide requirement
Ideal shade/border tree in coffee and areca plantations
Booming export as vegan meat substitute

name: Jamun (Java Plum / Nerale)
confidenceNote: Chikkaballapur (Chintamani GI Nerale) and Konkan bold seeded benchmarks (Dhupdal / CISH J-37).
waterMm: 400-600 mm, tolerates seasonal inundation and salinity
spacing: 8 m x 8 m or on farm borders and water channels
fertilizerSchedule: 20 kg compost + 250g N, 150g P, 250g K per tree annually.
harvestSigns: Berries turn deep glossy purple-black and soften.
storageAdvice: Pack in cushioned shallow cartons; highly perishable, market within 48 hours or freeze pulp.
intercroppingOptions: Pulses and vegetables in early years
description: Jamun (Chintamani Nerale) is nature's most powerful anti-diabetic fruit containing jamboline. Large fleshy fruits sell for ₹150-₹250/kg in South Indian metros, with zero chemical spray needs.
descriptionKn: ಚಿಂತಾಮಣಿಯ ದಪ್ಪ ಗಾತ್ರದ ನೇರಳೆ ಹಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಮಧುಮೇಹಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಿ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯಿದೆ. ಕೆಜಿಗೆ ₹150-250 ಬೆಲೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: நாவல் பழம் சர்க்கரை நோயை கட்டுப்படுத்தும் மாபெரும் இயற்கை மருந்து. சந்தையில் மிக அதிக விலைக்கு போகும்.
descriptionTe: నేరేడు పండ్లు మధుమేహ నివారణకు అద్భుతమైనవి. మార్కెట్లో అత్యంత ఖరీదైన ధర పలుకుతాయి.
risks: Fruit fly during ripening if harvest is delayed
benefits: Zero chemical spraying needed
Huge price premiums for anti-diabetic health properties

name: Jasmine (Mysore Mallige / Gundu Malli)
confidenceNote: Mysore Mallige & Madurai Malli GI tagged fragrant flower benchmarks.
harvestMonths: March to October daily early morning picking
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 kg/bush + 120:240:240g N:P:K per bush annually after annual pruning in December-January.
harvestSigns: Unopened firm white flower buds picked between 5:00 AM and 8:00 AM.
storageAdvice: Wrap in banana leaves and pack in ice thermocol boxes for air shipment.
description: Mysore Mallige and Madurai Malli are world-renowned GI tagged jasmine varieties. High-value essential oil and daily pooja garland demand yields extraordinary daily profits.
descriptionKn: ಭೌಗೋಳಿಕ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ (GI Tag) ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಮೈಸೂರು ಮಲ್ಲಿಗೆಯು ಅಸಾಧಾರಣ ಸುವಾಸನೆ ಮತ್ತು ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ನಗದು ಆದಾಯ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: மதுரை மல்லி புவிசார் குறியீடு பெற்ற உலகப் புகழ்பெற்ற நறுமண மலர். தினசரி காலை ரொக்க வருமானம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: మల్లె పూలు దక్షిణ భారతదేశంలో మహిళలు మరియు పూజలకు నిత్యావసరం. ప్రతిరోజూ ఉదయాన్నే చేతికి పైసలు.
risks: Bud worm (Hendecasis duplifascialis) boring into unopened buds
Red spider mite
benefits: Daily morning cash income for 8 months of the year
Prices skyrocket to ₹800-₹2000/kg during wedding and festival seasons

name: Kodo Millet (Haraka / Varagu)
confidenceNote: Verified minor millet package of practices from TNAU & UAS Bangalore.
fertilizerSchedule: 20:10:10 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Plants turn yellow and panicles harden.
storageAdvice: Grain keeps fresh for over 10 years when dried properly.
description: Kodo millet (Varagu/Haraka) is legendary for its long shelf life and high antioxidant content. Extremely resilient to both drought and inundation.
descriptionKn: ಹಾರಕವು 10 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಕೆಡದೆ ಉಳಿಯುವ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಧಾನ್ಯ. ಆಂಟಿಆಕ್ಸಿಡೆಂಟ್‌ಗಳ ಆಗರ.
descriptionTa: வரகு பல்லாண்டுகள் கெடாமல் இருக்கும் அற்புத தானியம். உடலில் நச்சுக்களை நீக்கும் ஆற்றல் கொண்டது.
descriptionTe: అరికెలు ఎన్నో ఏళ్లు నిల్వ ఉండే దివ్యమైన చిరుధాన్యం. యాంటీఆక్సిడెంట్లు సమృద్ధిగా ఉంటాయి.
risks: Ergot / head smut in wet harvest seasons
benefits: Zero pest issues during grain storage
Highest antioxidant capacity among millets

name: Kokum (Punarpuli / Murugalu)
confidenceNote: Western Ghats GI tagged fat burner and cooling juice berry (Konkan Amruta / Chithira).
rainfallMm: 1200-2500 mm in coastal and Malnad foothill tracts
seedRate: 60-70 soft-wood grafted female plants/acre (with 10% male trees)
spacing: 7 m x 7 m or on plantation borders
fertilizerSchedule: 20 kg compost + 200g N, 100g P, 200g K per tree annually.
harvestSigns: Fruits turn deep crimson purple and soften.
storageAdvice: Sun dry salted outer rinds for culinary kokum rind; press seeds for kokum butter (substitute for cocoa butter).
potentialYieldPerAcre: 30 - 50 kg fresh fruit per tree (approx. 2-3 tonnes dried rind/acre)
description: Kokum (Punarpuli) is the famous Western Ghats souring fruit rich in Hydroxycitric Acid (HCA), the world's leading natural fat burner and refreshing summer sherbet base.
descriptionKn: ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಘಟ್ಟಗಳ ಅಮೃತ ಫಲ. ಪುನರ್ಪುಳಿಯ ಸಿಪ್ಪೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೀಜದ ಬೆಣ್ಣೆ (Kokum Butter) ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವರ್ಧಕ ಮತ್ತು ಜ್ಯೂಸ್ ಉದ್ಯಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கோக்கம் உடலின் கொழுப்பை குறைக்கும் மருத்துவ குணம் கொண்ட பாரம்பரிய புளிப்பு பழம்.
descriptionTe: కోకం బరువు తగ్గించే ఆయుర్వేద పండు. వేసవి దాహార్తిని తీర్చే జ్యూస్‌లకు అత్యంత ఆదరణ.
risks: Fruit borer in summer
benefits: Rind and seed butter both have separate high-value industrial markets
Zero chemical spraying required

name: Lemongrass (Essential Oil)
confidenceNote: CIMAP Lucknow and KAU Odakkali aromatic oil benchmarks (Krishna / Cauvery).
harvestMonths: First cut at 90 days, then every 60-70 days (4-5 cuts/year)
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 5 tonnes + 30:20:20 kg N:P:K per acre annually.
harvestSigns: Cut foliage 10 cm above ground when leaves are deep green and highly fragrant.
storageAdvice: Steam distil in field boiler within 24 hours of cutting to extract pure citral essential oil.
description: Lemongrass is an aromatic grass yielding high-value citral essential oil used in perfumes, soaps, and herbal teas. Animals will not graze it, making it ideal for unfenced open lands.
descriptionKn: ನಿಂಬೆ ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ತೈಲಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಬೂನು ಮತ್ತು ಸುಗಂಧ ದ್ರವ್ಯ ಉದ್ಯಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಿ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯಿದೆ. ಹಸು-ಕುರಿಗಳು ಇದನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
descriptionTa: எலுமிச்சை புல் எண்ணெய் வாசனை திரவியங்கள் மற்றும் மருந்துகளில் பயன்படும் சிறந்த லாபகரமான பயிர்.
descriptionTe: నిమ్మగడ్డి నూనె సుగంధ పరిమళాల పరిశ్రమలో అత్యంత ఆదరణ పొందినది. పశువులు ముట్టని సులువైన సాగు.
risks: Rust in rainy winter months
benefits: Livestock-proof (animals refuse to eat it)
Ready industrial cash demand for pure essential oil

name: Lentil (Masoor)
confidenceNote: Specialized Rabi pulse for North Karnataka deep black soils with cool winters.
fertilizerSchedule: 10:20:0 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Plants turn golden brown and pods harden.
storageAdvice: Sun dry to 10% moisture.
description: Lentil (Masoor dal) is an easily digestible cool-season pulse growing well in residual moisture in Northern Karnataka.
descriptionKn: ಚಳಿಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಪ್ಪು ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ತೇವಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಪೌಷ್ಟಿಕ ಬೇಳೆ.
descriptionTa: குளிர்காலத்தில் கரிசல் நிலத்தில் எஞ்சிய ஈரப்பதத்தில் வளரும் பருப்பு.
descriptionTe: శీతాకాలంలో తక్కువ నీటితో పండే పోషక విలువలున్న పప్పు పంట.
risks: Wilt in poorly drained soils
benefits: Low input cost
Very fast cooking dal with steady consumer demand

name: Little Millet (Saame / Samai)
confidenceNote: Indigenous millet package of practices for hill and tribal tracts of Western Ghats and Deccan.
fertilizerSchedule: 15:8:8 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Crops turn pale straw yellow with nodding panicles.
storageAdvice: Sun dry on mats until moisture is below 11%.
description: Little millet (Samai/Saame) can grow in the poorest gravelly soils with minimal water. Highly valued for diabetic friendly rice substitute.
descriptionKn: ಸಾಮೆಯು ಬಂಜರು ಮತ್ತು ಕಲ್ಲು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲೂ ಸಲೀಸಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುವ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಸಿರಿಧಾನ್ಯ.
descriptionTa: சாமை ஏழை நிலங்களிலும் விளையும் மிகச்சிறந்த சிறுதானியம். அரிசிக்கு சிறந்த மாற்று.
descriptionTe: సామలు అతి తక్కువ నీటితో చవుడు, రాతి నేలల్లో కూడా పండే పోషక ధాన్యం.
risks: Rust in damp weather
Shoot fly in early stages
benefits: Grows in marginal lands where nothing else succeeds
Rich in dietary fiber and B-complex vitamins

name: Maize (Corn)
confidenceNote: High-production crop of Davanagere, Haveri, Belagavi and Salem districts.
fertilizerSchedule: 60:30:20 kg N:P:K per acre (apply N in 3 splits at sowing, knee-high, and silking).
harvestSigns: Husk turns dry papery yellow and cob silk dries completely dark brown.
storageAdvice: Dry shelled corn to 12% moisture in grain silos.
description: Maize is a high-yielding cereal with booming demand from poultry and cattle feed industries across South India.
descriptionKn: ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳವು ಕೋಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ಜಾನುವಾರು ಆಹಾರ ಉದ್ಯಮದಿಂದಾಗಿ ಭಾರಿ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯಿರುವ ಆದಾಯದ ಬೆಳೆ.
descriptionTa: மக்காச்சோளம் கோழித்தீவன ஆலைகளுக்கு பெருமளவில் தேவைப்படும் அதிக லாபகரமான தானியப் பயிர்.
descriptionTe: మొక్కజొన్న పౌల్ట్రీ పరిశ్రమకు ముడిసరుకుగా అత్యధిక డిమాండ్ ఉన్న లాభదాయకమైన వాణిజ్య ధాన్య పంట.
risks: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) attack on whorls
Waterlogging at seedling stage
benefits: Very high yield per acre (30+ quintals)
Ready cash sale at feed mills and mandis

name: Mango (Alphonso / Kesar / Totapuri)
confidenceNote: Srinivaspur / Kolar (Mango capital of South India) & Salem mango benchmarks.
rainfallMm: 750-1200 mm with dry spell during flowering (Dec-Feb)
seedRate: 60-70 grafted saplings/acre (normal: 8m x 8m) or 200 saplings (Ultra High Density: 4m x 2m)
spacing: 8 m x 8 m or 4 m x 2 m (UHDP)
fertilizerSchedule: 50 kg FYM + 1 kg N, 0.5 kg P, 1 kg K per mature tree annually after harvest in July-August.
harvestSigns: Shoulders of fruit rise above stem attachment; color breaks from olive green to light yellow.
storageAdvice: Harvest with 1 cm stalk to prevent latex burn; ripen in ethylene chambers at 20-22°C.
description: Mango is the King of Fruits. Srinivaspur (Kolar) in Karnataka and Salem in Tamil Nadu produce premier Alphonso, Raspuri, Mallika, and Totapuri for pulp and table exports.
descriptionKn: ಕೋಲಾರದ ಶ್ರೀನಿವಾಸಪುರವು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತದ ಮಾವಿನ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ. ಆಲ್ಫೋನ್ಸೊ, ರಸಪೂರಿ, ತೋತಾಪುರಿ ತಳಿಗಳು ದೇಶ-ವಿದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಖ್ಯಾತಿ ಗಳಿಸಿವೆ.
descriptionTa: சேலம் மாம்பழம் உலகப்புகழ் பெற்றது. மாந்தோப்பு அமைத்து பல தலைமுறைகளுக்கு நிலையான வருமானம் பெறலாம்.
descriptionTe: బంగినపల్లి, తోతాపురి మామిడి తోటలు ఆంధ్ర, తెలంగాణలో తరతరాలకు సిరులు కురిపించే శాశ్వత సంపద.
risks: Mango hopper pest damaging flower panicles
Powdery mildew fungus during winter mist
Alternate bearing habit in some cultivars
benefits: Generates recurring cash revenue for 40+ years
Massive industrial demand for Totapuri pulp export

name: Marigold (African / French)
confidenceNote: Major festival and xanthophyll dye extraction flower of Gundlupet and Sathyamangalam (Pusa Narangi / Maxima Yellow).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 40:40:30 kg N:P:K per acre (pinch terminal shoot at 30 days to induce heavy branching).
harvestSigns: Flowers fully open with tight, compact petals.
storageAdvice: Pick early morning; pack in ventilated bamboo baskets or gunny bags with light water sprinkling.
intercroppingOptions: Companion border crop with tomato/chilli (suppresses root-knot nematodes)
description: Marigold is the premier fast-cash commercial flower of South India. Commands immense festival demand during Dasara, Ayudha Pooja, and Diwali, as well as steady purchase by poultry pigment extraction factories.
descriptionKn: ಗುಂಡ್ಲುಪೇಟೆಯ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಚೆಂಡುಹೂ. ದಸರಾ, ದೀಪಾವಳಿ ಹಬ್ಬಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕೋಳಿ ಆಹಾರ ಬಣ್ಣ ತೆಗೆಯುವ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಭರ್ಜರಿ ಮಾರಾಟವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: செண்டுமல்லி ஆயுதபூஜை மற்றும் தீபாவளி பண்டிகைகளில் தங்கமாக விலை போகும் குறுகிய கால மலர் பயிர்.
descriptionTe: బంతి పూలు దసరా, దీపావళి పండుగల వేళ రైతులకు కనకవర్షం కురిపించే అతి తక్కువ కాలపు పూల తోట.
risks: Bud borer and red spider mites in dry heat
Leaf spot (Alternaria) during heavy rain
benefits: Harvest starts 50 days after transplanting
Exudes alpha-terthienyl from roots, eradicating plant parasitic nematodes

name: Mint (Pudina)
confidenceNote: High menthol content multi-cut commercial herb (Kosi / Shivalik).
harvestMonths: First cut at 60 days, then every 35-40 days year-round
spacing: 40 cm x 20 cm in flat wet beds
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 40:20:25 kg N:P:K per acre (top dress 20 kg Urea after each cut).
harvestSigns: Lush dark green fragrant leafy stems 20-30 cm high.
storageAdvice: Pack in wet gunny sacks; market early morning for tea stalls and biryani restaurants.
description: Mint (Pudina) is an essential culinary herb. Yielding 6-7 cuttings per year with refreshing menthol aroma, it enjoys non-stop demand from biryani houses, tea shops, and juice stalls.
descriptionKn: ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ 6-7 ಬಾರಿ ಕಟಾವು ನೀಡುವ ಪುದೀನಾ, ಹೋಟೆಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿರಿಯಾನಿ ಉದ್ಯಮಕ್ಕೆ ನಿರಂತರ ಸರಬರಾಜಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: புதினா உணவகங்கள் மற்றும் தேநீர் கடைகளுக்கு தினசரி தேவைப்படும் அதிக லாபகரமான மூலிகை.
descriptionTe: పుదీనా ఏడాదికి 6-7 కోతలు ఇచ్చే నిరంతర ఆదాయ పంట. హోటళ్లు, బిర్యానీ పాయింట్లకు నిత్యావసరం.
risks: Rust in winter cold
Stolon rot in waterlogged clay
benefits: 6-7 cuttings per year from single stolon planting
Enormous daily demand in biryani and restaurant trade

name: Moth Bean (Matki)
confidenceNote: Extreme arid pulse for drought-prone sandy loam belts.
fertilizerSchedule: 10:15:0 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Pods turn yellowish brown.
storageAdvice: Dry to 9% moisture in sealed bags.
description: Moth bean (Matki) is the most drought and heat-tolerant legume in existence, thriving in extreme arid environments.
descriptionKn: ಅತ್ಯಂತ ತೀವ್ರ ಬರವನ್ನು ತಡೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಮಡಿಕೆ ಕಾಳು, ಮೊಳಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ತಿನ್ನಲು ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ.
descriptionTa: கடும் வறட்சியிலும் விளையும் சத்தான நரிப்பயறு.
descriptionTe: తీవ్రమైన ఎండలను కూడా తట్టుకుని పండే అమూల్యమైన పప్పు ధాన్యం.
risks: Bacterial leaf spot
benefits: Thrives in extreme heat (up to 42°C)
High price for sprouted pulse delicacy

name: Mulberry (Silk Farming / Reshme)
confidenceNote: Ramanagara (Silk City of India) & Kolar bivoltine silk benchmarks (V-1 / G-4 / Vishala).
durationDays: Perennial bush (15-20 years with 5-6 silk cocoon crops per year)
seasons: Year-round (5 to 6 silkworm rearing batches per year)
spacing: 150 cm x 60 cm (paired row for shoot feeding)
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 10 tonnes + 120:50:50 kg N:P:K per acre/year in 5 splits (after each shoot harvest).
harvestSigns: Lush nutritious green leaves with 70% moisture and 22-24% crude protein fed to silkworms.
storageAdvice: Shoot feed to silkworms in rearing house; harvest cocoons at day 6 after spinning and market at Government Silk Cocoon Market.
description: Mulberry sericulture powers Karnataka's legendary Mysore Silk industry. Ramanagara and Kolar farmers earn ₹3-4 Lakhs net profit per acre annually with 5-6 fast silk cocoon crops.
descriptionKn: ರಾಮನಗರದ ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ನಾಡಿನ ಅತಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕೃಷಿ ಉದ್ಯಮ. ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ 5-6 ಬಾರಿ ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ಗೂಡು ಮಾರಿ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ ₹30,000-50,000 ನಿರಂತರ ಆದಾಯ ಗಳಿಸಬಹುದು.
descriptionTa: பட்டுப்புழு வளர்ப்பிற்கு பயன்படும் மல்பெரி ஆண்டுக்கு 5 முறை பட்டுக்கூடு அறுவடை தந்து அதிக லாபம் ஈட்டும்.
descriptionTe: పట్టు పరిశ్రమ రైతులకు ప్రతి రెండు నెలలకోసారి నికర లాభాలు అందించే అత్యుత్తమ కుటీర వ్యవసాయ పరిశ్రమ.
risks: Silkworm flacherie and grasserie disease if hygiene is neglected
Thrips and tukra mealybug on leaves
benefits: Guaranteed Government Silk Cocoon e-auction markets with instant electronic bank transfer
Provides 5-6 incomes per year

name: Muskmelon / Cantaloupe (Kharbooja)
confidenceNote: Anantapur and Bellary premier sweet summer crop (Kundan / Madhuras / Arka Jeet).
rainfallMm: Riverbed / drip irrigation with plastic mulch
spacing: 2 m x 0.5 m on plastic mulch with drip
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 40:25:35 kg N:P:K per acre (stop watering 4 days before picking).
harvestSigns: Half-slip stage (fruit detaches with slight pressure) and netting turns creamy white with intense aroma.
storageAdvice: Pack in ventilated cartons; holds 5-7 days at ambient temperature.
description: Muskmelon (Kharbooja/Kirini Pazham) is the sweet, fragrant superstar of summer farming. Ready in just 75 days, delivering rapid cash flow during the hottest months.
descriptionKn: ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯ ಕರಬೂಜ ಕೇವಲ 75 ದಿನದಲ್ಲೇ ಬಂದು, ನಗರಗಳ ಜ್ಯೂಸ್ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಬೆಲೆ ಗಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கிருணிப்பழம் கோடையில் தாகம் தணிக்கும் நறுமணமிக்க பழம். 75 நாட்களில் அதிக லாபம் தரும்.
descriptionTe: ఖర్బూజ వేసవిలో అత్యధిక డిమాండ్ ఉండే తీపి పండ్ల పంట. కేవలం 75 రోజుల్లో రైతుకు నగదు తెస్తుంది.
risks: Powdery and downy mildew in damp nights
Fruit cracking if heavily watered near maturity
benefits: Fast 75-day cash turnover
Extremely popular summer fresh juice and smoothie item in Indian cities

name: Mustard (Sasive / Kadugu)
confidenceNote: Indigenous seasoning black mustard and winter oilseed (Kranti / Pusa Bold).
rainfallMm: Residual soil moisture in winter black vertisols
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 4 tonnes + 30:15:15 kg N:P:K + Sulphur 15 kg/acre (essential for pungent allyl isothiocyanate).
harvestSigns: Pods turn golden yellow and seeds turn dark brown/black inside siliquae.
storageAdvice: Sun dry on threshing floor to 8% moisture; store in moisture-proof drums.
description: Black mustard (Sasive/Kadugu/Avalu) is the fundamental tempering seasoning in every South Indian kitchen. Requires minimal inputs and thrives in cool winter soils.
descriptionKn: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಒಗ್ಗರಣೆಗೆ ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾದ ಸಾಸಿವೆ, ಚಳಿಗಾಲದ ಕಪ್ಪು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಖರ್ಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: கடுகு தாளிப்பிற்கு இன்றியமையாத பாரம்பரிய மசாலா-எண்ணெய் வித்து பயிர்.
descriptionTe: ఆవాలు ప్రతి తెలుగింటి పోపులో ప్రాణ సమానం. శీతాకాలంలో తక్కువ నీటితో పండే పంట.
risks: Mustard aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) during cold cloudy weather
White rust
benefits: Essential kitchen commodity with non-stop daily consumption
Low cost of cultivation

name: Niger Seed (Huchchellu / Uchellu)
confidenceNote: Indigenous tribal and rainfed minor oilseed of North Karnataka & Nilgiris (KBN 1 / Birsa Niger 2).
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 2 tonnes + 10:10:0 kg N:P:K per acre.
harvestSigns: Heads turn dark brown and leaves wither.
storageAdvice: Sun dry on clean tarpaulins; dry to 7% moisture.
description: Niger seed (Huchchellu/Valasalu) is North Karnataka's beloved chutney pudi oilseed. Grows effortlessly in degraded stony soils with zero fertilizers, adored by honeybees for its bright yellow nectar flowers.
descriptionKn: ಉತ್ತರ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಹುಚ್ಚೆಳ್ಳು ಚಟ್ನಿ ಪುಡಿಗೆ ಬಳಸುವ ಎಣ್ಣೆಕಾಳು. ಬಂಜರು ಮತ್ತು ಕಲ್ಲು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲೂ ಸಲೀಸಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
descriptionTa: பேயெள் வறண்ட மலைப்பகுதிகளில் மிகக் குறைந்த செலவில் விளையும் பாரம்பரிய எண்ணெய் வித்து.
descriptionTe: వలసలు ఉత్తర కర్ణాటక మరియు రాయలసీమ సరిహద్దుల్లో చట్నీ పొడులకు వాడే ఆరోగ్యకరమైన నూనెగింజ.
risks: Cuscuta parasitic weed in uncleaned seed lots
benefits: Thrives on degraded, rocky soils unsuitable for other crops
Exceptional forage plant for honeybees during autumn

name: Onion
confidenceNote: Bangalore Rose Onion (GI tagged export) and Bellary Big Onion benchmarks.
seedRate: 3-4 kg/acre (direct seeds) or 400 kg bulbs/acre (shallots/small onion)
fertilizerSchedule: FYM 8 tonnes + 40:20:30 kg N:P:K + Sulphur 15 kg/acre (essential for pungency and storage).
harvestSigns: 50% of the plant tops (necks) bend and fall over.
storageAdvice: Field cure bulbs under shade for 5-7 days; store in well-ventilated bamboo onion storage structures.
description: Onion is an indispensable culinary staple. South India produces both big Bellary onions and high-value export shallots (Bangalore Rose Onion & Sambhar Vengayam).
